title: Junior Associate/Associate - AI Prompt & Market Rollout Specialist
description:
Job Title: Junior Associate/Associate \- AI Prompt \& Market Rollout Specialist
   

  

 Career Level: C1/C2
   

  

**Introduction To Role**
 Are you ready to turn cutting\-edge generative AI into better customer conversations that ultimately improve patient outcomes? Join the team scaling an AI Coach that uses Meta\-Skills Avatars to elevate field engagement across multiple brands and markets. You will help translate global benchmark avatars into market\-ready experiences, shaping a strategic capability that connects technology, commercial excellence, and measurable impact in the field.
   

  

 You will orchestrate complex, parallel rollouts across 40–50 markets while getting hands\-on with prompt and context engineering for six brands, with potential expansion into additional therapy areas. Working closely with Commercial, Medical Excellence, GBS, and Commercial IT stakeholders, you will drive quality, speed, and adoption from pilot to launch. Can you balance precision in prompts with the pace needed to deliver hundreds of avatars in year one?
   

  

 Based in India and aligned to European time zones, you will operate in English and collaborate globally, coordinating market stakeholders and enabling rapid adaptation within our governance and compliance frameworks.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Market coordination: Build and maintain market\-specific rollout plans to achieve on\-time pilots and launches across 40–50 markets; manage dependencies, sequencing, and cross\-market timelines to keep the program moving at pace.
* Prompt and context engineering: Customize 3–4 scenarios per brand and approximately nine prompts per scenario, adapting persona, language, and local context while preserving core feedback logic to improve realism and learning outcomes.
* Avatar adaptation: Guide markets to complete fast\-turn adaptations (1–6 hours per avatar), including persona and face changes, language localization, and scenario tweaks; validate first\-time translations to reduce rework and maintain precision.
* Testing and QA orchestration: Run market testing cycles, capture structured feedback, iterate prompts quickly, and ensure regulatory, medical, and brand alignment across commercial use cases.
* Governance and change management: Partner with change leads to socialize the AI Coach, manage approval gates, and sustain adoption metrics; keep leadership informed with clear, cadence\-based reporting.
* Capacity planning: Model throughput to hit an annual target of 200–250 avatars; forecast resource needs and recommend resourcing plans and support model enhancements to meet business priorities.
* Stakeholder integration: Collaborate across GBS, Commercial IT, and business teams to evolve enterprise\-wide prompt and context engineering capability, connecting technical work to commercial value.
* Enablement and training: Leverage Meta\-Skills onboarding, support SME training for Avatar Studio, and produce templates and playbooks that standardize market adaptations to reduce variance.
* Risk and compliance: Apply brand, medical, and regulatory guardrails consistently; surface risks early and drive mitigation across markets and brands to protect quality and speed.


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Experience: 4\-6 years in commercial learning technologies, conversational AI, or digital rollout across multiple markets; experience coordinating vendors and internal teams.
* Technical skills: Hands\-on with generative AI prompting, context curation, and scenario design; familiarity with avatar\-based simulations and feedback frameworks.
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of pharma commercial practices (PCS/customer engagement), brand localization, and approval workflows; knowledge of medical/market access contexts is a plus.
* Language and localization: Experience guiding multilingual deployments; comfortable validating translations for accuracy and tone, even when core logic remains unchanged.
* Project delivery: Strong program coordination, QA, and governance execution; adept at tracking milestones across parallel rollouts. Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Communication: Clear, structured communication with market stakeholders and executives; ability to produce concise status, risks, and adoption insights.
* Tools: Exposure to Avatar Studio or similar; prompt repositories, QA frameworks, and basic analytics; SSO\-aware user flows and compliance processes.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience with RAG\-enhanced prompting.
* Prior work in BBU brands or similar therapeutic areas; understanding of iCVA, adoption ladders, and objection handling.


 Background in GBS/Commercial IT or Commercial Excellence teams, bridging business and technology.
   

  

**When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the** 
 power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
   

  

**Why AstraZeneca**
 Here, your expertise powers meaningful change. You will join a global, fast\-moving community that pairs scientific ambition with real\-world impact, using data, predictive analytics and smart automation to reimagine how we work for the benefit of patients with unmet needs. We bring unexpected teams together to spark bold ideas, move decisively, and support one another with kindness as well as ambition. With significant investment in digital capabilities and a culture that encourages thoughtful risk\-taking and continuous learning, you will have the scope to shape enterprise\-scale solutions and see your work contribute directly to better outcomes for patients and society.
   

  

**Call To Action**
 If you are ready to build a strategic AI capability and see your work elevate field engagement across markets, submit your application and help us deliver smarter coaching at scale today!
   

  

**Date Posted**
 07\-Sept\-2026
   

  

**Closing Date**
 AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry\-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non\-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Geospatial Analyst
description:
**About AiDASH**  

  

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.



The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.



Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

### **The Role**



As a Geospatial Analyst at AiDASH, you will produce high\-quality annotated datasets from diverse imagery sources — satellite, LiDAR, aerial, and ground\-based panoramic images and videos. Your work will directly feed AI/ML pipelines and client deliverables that protect critical infrastructure. This role demands a sharp eye for detail, comfort working with visual and geospatial data at scale, and fluency with modern AI tools. You won't just annotate images; you'll build AI\-accelerated workflows that make the entire team faster.


### **How** **You'll** **Make an Impact**


* Annotate and label imagery (satellite, LiDAR, aerial, drone, ground\-based panoramic photos and videos) to identify, classify, and delineate features such as vegetation, assets, terrain, and infrastructure components
* Prepare, extract, and organize spatial and non\-spatial data based on AI model and customer delivery requirements
* Review annotated data for patterns, trends, and quality issues using annotation platforms and in\-house tools
* Use AI tools and assistants to accelerate annotation and workflows, auto\-generate documentation, and draft reports
* Perform annotation tasks including object classification, digitization, geo\-referencing, and feature creation across multi\-source imagery
* Leverage generative AI tools to build automations or semi\-automated annotation pipelines that boost team productivity
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to define annotation guidelines, refine labelling schemas, and ensure datasets meet model training and delivery standards
* Ensure productivity targets are met with utmost focus on annotation quality, consistency, and adherence to project specifications

### **What** **We're** **Looking For**


* 1 to 4 years of work experience in imagery annotation, image analysis, remote sensing, or a related domain
* Hands\-on experience with annotation and labelling platforms; familiarity with GIS software is an added advantage
* Demonstrated use of generative AI tools(e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to enhance day\-to\-day work — whether for analysis, drafting reports, automating repetitive tasks, improving annotation speed, or any other productivity gains
* Comfortable using Gen AI tools to draft reports, generate annotation guidelines, and summarize analysis outputs with sound judgment
* Working knowledge of Python or scripting for data processing and automation is preferred; geospatial libraries are a bonus
* Experience working with satellite imagery, aerial photography, LiDAR point clouds, or video annotation for AI/ML pipelines
* Ability to learn quickly and develop deep functional knowledge of project specifications, annotation schemas, and quality procedures
* Strong focus on data quality, annotation accuracy, and consistency across large\-scale datasets


We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.



We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

**Construction Quality Expert – QA/QC \& Site Inspection**

**Location:** Bangalore  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**CTC:** ₹8–12 LPA  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Construction / ConTech

About Bandhoo

Bandhoo is a construction technology company building technology\-led solutions to improve **quality, transparency, and productivity** across the construction industry.

We are looking for a **Construction Quality Expert** with strong hands\-on experience in **construction QA/QC, quality inspections, snagging, defect identification, and site quality audits**.

This role is ideal for someone who has worked extensively on construction sites as a **QA/QC Engineer, Quality Engineer, QC Engineer, Quality Inspector, or QA/QC Manager** and can independently inspect construction work, identify defects, understand their root causes, and determine whether work meets the required quality standards.

**This is a hands\-on Quality role, not a Project Management role.** Candidates whose experience is primarily in project execution, project planning, project management, cost management, or client coordination without strong hands\-on QA/QC experience will not be suitable.

Key Responsibilities1\. Construction Quality Inspection

* Conduct detailed **site quality inspections and construction quality audits**.
* Inspect work across different stages of construction, including:
* RCC \& Structural Works
* Masonry / Blockwork
* Plastering
* Waterproofing
* Flooring \& Tiling
* Painting \& Finishing
* Doors \& Windows
* False Ceiling
* Plumbing
* Electrical \& MEP works
* Identify **defects, workmanship issues, deviations, incomplete works, and quality deficiencies**.
* Verify construction work against approved **drawings, specifications, BOQ, ITPs, method statements, and applicable quality standards**.
* Determine the severity and impact of identified defects.

2\. Snagging \& Defect Assessment

* Conduct **snagging, pre\-handover and quality inspections**.
* Prepare detailed snag/punch lists with:
* Defect description
* Location
* Photographs
* Severity
* Recommended corrective action
* Conduct **re\-inspections** after rectification and verify closure of defects.
* Identify recurring quality issues and their possible root causes.

3\. QA/QC Documentation

* Review and work with **ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs, inspection checklists, and quality reports**.
* Maintain quality inspection records and documentation.
* Evaluate contractor workmanship and adherence to approved quality standards.
* Support development of **quality checklists, defect categories and quality benchmarks**.

4\. Construction Quality \& CONSTRA

Bandhoo is building **CONSTRA**, an AI\-powered construction quality management platform.

The Quality Expert will:

* Use practical construction knowledge to help define **real\-world construction defects and quality issues**.
* Review and validate defects identified through site photographs/videos.
* Help create standardized **defect taxonomies, inspection checklists and quality benchmarks**.
* Provide expert feedback to the product and engineering teams to improve CONSTRA's quality assessment capabilities.
* Participate in pilot projects and testing of digital inspection workflows.

**No prior AI or technology experience is required. Strong construction quality expertise is what matters.**

5\. Site \& Client Assessments

* Conduct quality assessments at construction and real estate projects.
* Visit project sites across Bangalore and other locations when required.
* Interact with site engineers, contractors and client representatives to explain quality observations.
* Provide clear and practical recommendations for defect rectification.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate should have:

* **5–8 years of hands\-on construction QA/QC experience**.
* Strong experience in **construction quality inspection and defect identification**.
* Experience with **snagging, pre\-handover inspection, quality audits, and defect closure**.
* Strong knowledge of **civil construction and finishing quality**.
* Practical understanding of **ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs and material testing**.
* Ability to identify defects by physically inspecting construction work.
* Good understanding of **IS Codes and construction quality standards**.
* Experience evaluating contractor workmanship and quality compliance.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent.

Preferred Background

Candidates from the following backgrounds are preferred:

* QA/QC Engineer
* Senior QA/QC Engineer
* Quality Engineer
* Construction Quality Engineer
* QC Engineer
* Quality Inspector
* Construction Quality Auditor
* Snagging / Property Inspection Professional
* QA/QC Manager **with strong hands\-on site inspection experience**

Experience with **real estate developers, builders, PMC companies, construction companies, property inspection firms, or quality consultancies** will be an advantage.

Not Suitable For This Role

**Please do not apply if your experience is primarily in:**

* Project Management
* Project Planning
* Project Coordination
* Cost Management
* Contracts / Commercial
* Business Development
* General Site Management without strong QA/QC responsibility

**We are specifically looking for a Quality professional who can personally inspect construction work and identify what is wrong, why it is wrong, and how it should be rectified.**

Why Join Bandhoo?

* Work at the intersection of **Construction \+ Quality \+ AI \+ Technology**.
* Use your construction quality expertise to shape an AI\-powered quality platform.
* Work across multiple real estate and construction projects.
* Opportunity to build standardized construction\-quality practices using technology.
* Be part of a growing ConTech company transforming construction quality assessment.

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: IT Applications Engineer - Technology IT
description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
  
This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
  
  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function
  
1\. Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  
2\. Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  
3\. Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  
4\. Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  
5\. Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  
6\. Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  
7\. Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  
8\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  
9\. Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  
10\. AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  
11\. Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.
  
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES
  
  

**Essential:**  

1\. NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  
2\. Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  
3\. Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
  
4\. Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  
5\. APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  
6\. Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  
7\. Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
  
8\. Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  
9\. ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.
  
  

**Desirable:**  

1\. Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
2\. Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
  
3\. Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
  
4\. Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  
5\. Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  
6\. Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.
  
  

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  

If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  

\#LI\-AB1
  
  

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

description:

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18510 **Date posted** 09/06/2026
### **Alternate Job Titles**

* Senior Staff Verification Engineer
* Sr Staff Applications Engineer, Simulation \& Debug
* Principal Application Engineer, VCS/Verdi

* Sr Staff Technical Solutions Engineer, EDA

### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years in verification, the kind where a missed edge case costs six months and millions of dollars, and you have learned to think like both the designer who built it and the engineer trying to break it. You know that simulation is not just about running tests, it is about understanding why a testbench stalls at 3am, why coverage is stuck at 87%, and what it takes to get a customer from "this doesn't work" to "this is faster than anything we've run before."


You are comfortable sitting with a customer's verification team, digging into their UVM environment or gate\-level timing flow, and walking out with a deployment plan that actually works in their environment, not just in a demo. You do not wait for perfect documentation. You read waveforms, trace through SystemVerilog, script your way around problems, and know when to pull in R\&D versus solve it yourself.


Competitive benchmarks do not intimidate you. You have run them, you know where VCS wins, and you can explain it in terms that matter to the person signing the contract. You care about the craft. At Synopsys, you will work on verification technology that powers tape\-outs across the industry, and the customers you support will remember your name.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Drive customer deployments of VCS and Verdi simulation and debug platforms, working directly with design and verification teams to integrate tools into their existing flows
* Diagnose complex technical issues across UVM testbenches, gate\-level simulations, low power flows, and timing\-aware verification environments
* Lead competitive engagements and benchmarking efforts, demonstrating VCS/Verdi performance, capacity, and debug advantages against rival tools
* Collaborate with R\&D and product teams to gather customer requirements, reproduce field issues, and influence the product roadmap based on real deployment feedback
* Develop and optimize automation scripts in Perl, Python, TCL, Shell, and Make to improve customer productivity and streamline verification workflows
* Interface across global teams including product validation, field applications, and customer engineering to propose solutions and drive product improvements
* Support customers through technical escalations, providing expertise in SystemVerilog, SVA, UVM, low power (UPF), and gate\-level simulation methodologies

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to close verification faster and reach first\-pass silicon success by deploying simulation technology that scales to their toughest designs
* Influence the VCS and Verdi product roadmap by surfacing real\-world customer challenges and competitive gaps that R\&D can act on
* Win competitive deals by proving performance, capacity, and debug superiority in head\-to\-head benchmarks that matter to customer schedules
* Accelerate adoption of advanced features like AI\-driven productivity tools, formal integration, and next\-gen debug capabilities across your customer base
* Reduce time\-to\-resolution for critical customer issues, turning escalations into deployments and deployments into long\-term partnerships
* Strengthen Synopsys' position as the verification platform of choice by making customers successful in ways they can measure and defend internally
* Build institutional knowledge across the global applications team by documenting solutions, sharing best practices, and mentoring peers on complex verification challenges

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering or equivalent, with 5\-12 years of hands\-on experience in verification or application engineering
* Deep expertise in simulation technologies, UVM, SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), and verification methodologies applied to real designs
* Strong command of HDL languages including Verilog, VHDL, and SystemVerilog, with solid understanding of digital design fundamentals
* Proven experience with gate\-level simulation, timing\-aware verification, and low power flows using UPF
* Advanced scripting ability in Perl, Python, TCL, Shell, and Make, with comfort working in UNIX/Linux environments
* Experience with Synopsys Verdi or similar waveform debug tools is a strong plus, as is knowledge of DPI, C/C\+\+, SystemC, or functional safety standards
* Exposure to generative AI technologies or AI\-driven EDA workflows is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a verification problem described in half\-formed sentences, and walk out with a clear technical plan and next steps
* You are the person your team pulls in when a customer issue is stuck, not because you know everything, but because you know how to find the answer and who to ask
* You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, and you do not need reminders to follow up or close the loop
* You push back when a proposed solution does not fit the customer's actual environment, and you are comfortable saying "that won't work, here's what will"
* Travel does not faze you, whether it is onsite customer visits, regional workshops, or working across time zones with global R\&D and field teams
* You stay current, not because it is required, but because you are genuinely curious about what is next in verification, AI tooling, and EDA technology

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

### **Role Definition**



The Senior Design Engineer is responsible for the design, development, validation, and continuous improvement of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tools, including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, and associated wear components. The role applies advanced engineering principles, virtual product development tools, performance simulation, wear modeling, and validation methodologies to deliver solutions that improve customer productivity, wear life, durability, manufacturability, and total owning and operating costs.


### **Key Technical Responsibilities**


* Lead design and development of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tool (GET) components including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, shank protection systems and wear packages.
* Develop solutions that improve machine productivity, penetration performance, wear life, serviceability and customer value.
* Perform structural, fatigue, performance, and wear simulations to support design decisions and reduce physical validation cycles.
* Utilize Virtual Product Development (VPD) tools to predict stress, durability, material behavior, and wear characteristics under various customer applications.
* Develop and validate wear\-performance models using field data, laboratory testing, and simulation results.
* Analyze system interactions between blade, cutting edge, moldboard and ripper systems to optimize performance and life\-cycle cost.
* Evaluate alternative materials, heat treatments, casting, forging and wear technologies to improve product performance.
* Support prototype builds, laboratory testing, field validation and production implementation.
* Lead root\-cause investigations for field issues using analytical, simulation and test data.


**Skill Descriptors**:


**Analytical Thinking \& AI Uses:**



Knowledge of analytical techniques, engineering tools, simulation methods, and AI\-assisted technologies that promote effective problem solving; ability to identify root causes of design and performance issues and develop multiple solutions that optimize customer value, durability, manufacturability, and cost.


**Effective Communications:**



Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.


**Managing Multiple Priorities:**



Knowledge of effective self\-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.


**Technical Excellence \& Innovation**:



Knowledge of mining applications, Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems, wear technologies, and engineering methodologies; ability to develop innovative solutions to complex technical challenges while improving customer value, product performance, durability, and cost competitiveness.


**Computer\-Aided Design \& Engineering:**



Knowledge of engineering tools (Creo, Teamcenter, ANSYS, DEM, Wear Simulation) and techniques of parametric design, simulation, and knowledge\-based engineering; ability to design, analyze, simulate, validate, and optimize Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems throughout the product development lifecycle.


**Product Design and Development:**



Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production.

* The role involves developing and maintaining UVM\-based verification environments, writing test benches, test cases, and coverage models for complex IP and SoC designs.
* The engineer will analyze specifications, define verification plans, create and execute verification scenarios, and debug RTL issues in close collaboration with design, architecture, and firmware teams.
* Daily tasks include running regressions, monitoring coverage metrics, performing root\-cause analysis of failures, and contributing to continuous improvement of verification methodologies and automation.
* The role may also include mentoring junior engineers, participating in design and verification reviews, and aligning verification activities with project schedules and quality standards.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 12\+ years of experience in Digital Verification with Strong expertise in System Verilog, UVM methodology and constrained\-random verification.
* Experience with Formal Verification techniques and tools to complement simulation\-based verification \- advantage.
* Solid understanding of Computer Architecture, including memory hierarchies, bus protocols, and high\-performance compute subsystems.
* Proficiency with verification tools and flows (e.g., simulators, waveform viewers, coverage tools, regression management, scripting in Python/Perl/Tcl).
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross\-functional, multicultural teams.
* Experience in semiconductor product development for automotive, industrial, or embedded systems is an advantage
* Strong English, availability to support and cooperate with external teams including Business travels.
* Experience using AI tools to accelerate code development, debugging, and improvement is an advantage.

  

**Additional Information**  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.


At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.


We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.


Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?


Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement.

title: Portfolio Lead
description:
**Company Description** **About Entain India**


There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.

 **Job Description**  

The Portfolio Lead is accountable for delivery performance across a sub\-domain of 4\-6 pods (Engineering, Quality, Product). They lead the flow of value from idea to production, ensuring pods deliver with pace, predictability and understanding to outcomes.


They combine hands\-on delivery leadership with AI\-augmented ways of working and data\-driven decision\-making. They do not prescribe a single framework \- instead they adapt approaches that best serve each pod's context.


They partner with Engineering and Product leadership to reduce waste, improve throughput and help pods achieve Autonomy, Accountability and Agreement to value outcomes.

**What you will do**

**Pod Performance \& Accountability**


You are responsible for pod delivery performance across the sub\-domain.


You will lead and communicate delivery health, risks and performance to leadership


Ensure pods operate as, self\-organising units delivering value outcomes


Support pod leads with coaching, facilitation and conflict resolution


Ensure cross\-pod agreement on priorities, dependencies and shared goals


Facilitate communication and collaboration between pods to promote knowledge sharing

**Problem Solving**


You will be an expert; deploy root cause analysis, systems thinking and structured techniques to analyse and guide out resolutions.


Be an escalation point for cross\-pod blockers and systemic impediments


Identify patterns across pods that indicate deeper organisational or process issues

**AI\-Augmented Delivery**


Champion AI agent adoption across pods \- including coding agents, test generation, story creation, board health and deployment automation


Identify opportunities where AI can reduce toil, accelerate delivery or improve decision\-making


Apply AI to improve delivery effectiveness, including workflow insights, risk prediction, and automation of reporting


Track and demonstrate the impact of AI on delivery performance

**Flow \& Efficiency**


Monitor and improve delivery flow (lead time, cycle time, WIP, throughput) using Kanban and lean principles


Ensure WIP limits are respected and surface ageing items through Board Walks


Identify bottlenecks, ageing work and sources of delay across pods.


Improve through regular assessment and experimentation.


Support teams in breaking down work into deliverable, value\-driven increments

**Agile Ways of Working**


Support and evolve the agile operating model for a pod\-based environment focused on pace, not ceremony.


Adapt delivery approaches (Kanban, flow\-based, lean) appropriate to each pod's needs


Ensure consistency of practice across pods without being prescriptive


Promote outcome\-driven delivery vs output\-driven activity


Guide teams to operate with autonomy and accountability

**Metrics \& Reporting**


Define and maintain delivery metrics: cycle time, flow efficiency, lead time of initiative, PDLC compression, dependency reduction, rework rate, team satisfaction, and AI effectiveness


Build dashboards (cumulative flow diagrams, throughput charts, WIP ageing) that provide leadership visibility and lead informed decision\-making


Analyse performance data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement


Use data to facilitate conversations and coach pods — not just track output

**Stakeholder Management**


Partner with Engineering and Product leadership at sub\-domain level


Represent delivery health and risks in leadership forums


Build trusted relationships that allow fast decision\-making


Communicate delivery performance to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Commercial Awareness**


Understand the commercial context of the sub\-domain


Connect delivery decisions to revenue, cost, and customer impact


Support prioritisation trade\-offs with a business lens

**Capacity Planning**


Forecast capacity across pods based on team composition, skills mix and upcoming demand


Identify resourcing gaps and support hiring/allocation decisions


Balance workload across pods to prevent burnout and underutilisation


Support realistic planning by ensuring pods have clear understanding of available capacity

**Risk \& Dependency Management**


Manage risks through regular assessment and execution of controls


Ensure cross\-pod dependencies are visible, tracked and managed


Track dependency cost (time blocked, items affected) and lead mitigations such as contract\-first development and feature flags


Support issue escalations, ensuring intervention by the dependency escalation protocol

**Coach \& Capability Development**


Provide hands\-on coaching at pod level


Build capability in workflow management, flow thinking, estimation, planning, and data\-led decision\-making


Support teams in understanding and improving their own performance


Strengthen a culture of continuous improvement and learning

**Outcome \& Value Focus**


Align delivery to always ensure outcomes and value.


Help teams understand the why behind their work and how their outputs contribute to value


Challenge work that does not link to outcomes


Support measurement of delivery against OKRs and value indicators

**Centre of Excellence (CoE) Contribution**


Be an active contributor to the CoE


Share best practices, delivery insights and improvement opportunities from pods


Support adoption of standards, playbooks and tools


Help evolve delivery practices based on experience

 **Qualifications** **Specialist Experience**


You will have 7\+ years in delivery/agile roles, with at least 3 years operating across multiple teams simultaneously in a technology environment


Expert in flow\-based delivery approaches (Kanban, lean, continuous delivery) — not limited to Scrum


Experience enabling multiple teams/pods simultaneously at scale


Strong understanding of AI tooling and its application to software delivery (coding assistants, automation, intelligent analytics)


Experienced in capacity planning, demand forecasting and resource optimisation across multiple teams


Use data to solve complex problems; can interpret and communicate complex data sets clearly


Previous experience of organisational transformation and change management


Good knowledge of Objectives and Key Results (OKR) strategy


Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, fintech, or similar) desirable

**Competencies \& Behaviours**


You will embody the Maker Dimensions \- selecting for capability, not just competence. We are looking for people who are versatile, curious, and able to operate with autonomy in a high\-trust environment.

**AI Fluency** uses AI tooling; experiments; iterate with AI as a collaborator

**Agency \& Accountability** Owns outcomes, not just tasks; directs itself.

**Systems Thinking** Sees patterns across pods and addresses causes, not symptoms

**Stakeholder Engagement** Builds working relationships across pods and leadership

**Improve Performance** Raises the bar through data and experimentation

**Cross\-functional Versatility** Comfortable operating beyond their primary discipline

**Product Sense** Connects their work to customer and outcomes

**Build Capability** Invests in developing pods, individuals and self

 **Additional Information** **Benefits**


At Entain India, we offer a package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* INR 3,000 per month Communication allowance.
* Up to INR 16,000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3\).

**Equal Opportunities**.


If you need any **reasonable adjustments** at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.


We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.


We're an **equal opportunities employer**. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.


We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant - Snowflake

* Build AI\-powered solutions using Snowflake Cortex AI, including Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, and AI Functions

* Take part in architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and drive engineering best practices
* Partner with business and product teams to deliver high\-impact analytics and AI solutions

The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Fulltime graduation degree in a related field
* 10\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Analytics Engineering
* Hands\-on experience with DBT, Semantic Layer design, and CI/CD implementations
* Experience building AI\-enabled data solutions and working with LLM/Agent architectures
* Solid expertise in Snowflake, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT, and dimensional data modelling
* Proven technical leadership and stakeholder management skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands\-on technology leader who can bridge Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Governance, and AI Agent Architecture to deliver next\-generation healthcare data and AI solutions
* Experience with REST API integrations
* Cloud platform experience, preferably in Microsoft Azure
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
* Healthcare domain expertise with knowledge of data privacy, compliance, and regulated environments

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Director Of Engineering - Platform Services
description:
**About****Truveta**



Truveta is the world's first health provider\-led data platform, with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care.



Achieving this vision requires a talented and diverse team with expertise across healthcare, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and artificial intelligence. We are looking for people who are motivated by purposeful work and committed to building technology that can improve healthcare outcomes.



This position is based in **Hyderabad, India**.


**Who****We****Need**



Truveta is expanding its engineering presence in India to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges at global scale. We are seeking a collaborative and experienced engineering leader who can operate effectively across ambiguity, scale, and evolving requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high\-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. You should be comfortable balancing hands\-on technical leadership with people management and working with distributed teams across India and the United States.



If you are motivated by purposeful work, enjoy building teams and platforms from the ground up, and want to shape how data, AI, and engineering systems are powered internally, Truveta may be the right fit for you.


**This****Opportunity**



We are seeking a Director Of Engineering (POD Lead) to lead the Platform Services team in India.



The Platform Services team will build, manage, and operate the infrastructure that supports engineering teams across India and globally. The team will also own critical backend and platform services, including authentication, authorization, customer and consumer identity and access management, CI/CD, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, developer productivity tools, observability, and shared engineering services.



These services form the backbone of Truveta's engineering platform and have dependencies across multiple Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Product, and Security teams.



This is a **hands\-on technical leadership** role with people\-management responsibilities. You will be accountable for technical direction, delivery excellence, platform reliability, and team growth. You will work closely with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams in India and the United States.


**What****You'll****Do**


**Technical****and****Platform****Leadership**


* Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Platform Services and internal engineering platforms.
* Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure and backend services.
* Guide architecture decisions across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, identity, security, developer tooling, and shared services.
* Build and operate platforms that support engineering, data, machine learning, annotation, and internal workflow requirements.
* Lead the development and management of Kubernetes\-based platforms and cloud\-native services.
* Build and improve authentication, authorization, identity management, and access control services.
* Drive the development of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, and developer self\-service capabilities.
* Establish engineering standards for system design, API development, testing, code quality, observability, and operational readiness.
* Improve platform availability, scalability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and operational efficiency.
* Provide hands\-on technical guidance through design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, production\-readiness reviews, and incident responses.
* Balance near\-term delivery commitments with long\-term platform scalability, maintainability, and technical health.
* Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce operational overhead, and improve engineering productivity.


**Product****and****Delivery****Leadership**


* Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and define priorities.
* Translate business and engineering needs into clear technical strategies, milestones, and delivery plans.
* Ensure predictable, high\-quality delivery across multiple platform initiatives.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies and proactively address execution risks.
* Define and track success metrics related to platform adoption, reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
* Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions to stakeholders and senior leadership.


**POD****and****People****Leadership**


* Build, mentor, and grow a high\-performing engineering team in India.
* Provide technical direction, coaching, and support to engineers at different career levels.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
* Establish effective processes for planning, execution, prioritization, and retrospective learning.
* Encourage engineers to take ownership of services throughout their lifecycle, from design and development through production operations.
* Create an inclusive environment where team members can contribute, learn, and grow.


**Cross\-Functional****and****Global****Collaboration**


* Work closely with engineering teams across India and the United States to develop shared platforms and services.
* Partner effectively with U.S.\-based stakeholders across time zones.
* Represent the India Platform Services team in architecture, planning, and organizational forums.
* Serve as a key technical voice in discussions about platform strategy, engineering effectiveness, and future growth.
* Build strong relationships with internal customers and ensure that platform services meet the needs of the broader organization.


**Key****Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in technical leadership, engineering management, or people management.
* Experience leading engineering teams responsible for shared platforms, infrastructure, backend services, or developer tooling.
* Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and production\-grade backend services.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure and cloud\-native technologies.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, service discovery, and infrastructure operations.
* Experience building engineering infrastructure, internal platforms, workflow\-heavy systems, or developer productivity tools.
* Experience with authentication, authorization, identity management, or security\-focused backend services.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C\#, Java, Go, Python, or similar.
* Experience with modern API architectures, microservices, event\-driven systems, and service integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence.
* Familiarity with open\-source technologies and the ability to evaluate and adopt open\-source solutions.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices and Agile delivery methods.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed and cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred****Qualifications**


* Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, clinical data, or other highly regulated domains.
* Experience building platforms that support data engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or annotation workflows.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or other major cloud platforms.
* Experience with identity and access management technologies and protocols such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
* Experience with service mesh, API gateways, secrets management, policy enforcement, and zero\-trust security models.
* Experience defining service\-level objectives, reliability standards, and platform maturity models.
* Experience leading teams through significant organizational or platform growth.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering organizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, cost management, and optimization.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer (Salesforce Platform)
description:

The ideal candidate will possess strong Salesforce platform knowledge, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with global customers and cross\-functional teams. * Provide advanced technical support to Salesforce\-based applications and related integration; diagnose and resolve complex business, configuration, data, and platform issues.


* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned customers. Build trusted relationships; understand customer organizational structure and business priorities.


* Mentor junior support engineers through feedback, code review, and knowledge\-transfer sessions.


* Conduct root cause analyses on complex issues. Review team members' RCAs; validate investigation depth and remediation approaches.

* Drive process improvement initiatives. Identify gaps, propose solutions, and drive adoption.


* Collaborate with Product Development, CloudOps, Professional Services, and Customer Success to resolve complex issues.


* Lead product upgrades, testing, release validation, and post\-deployment support.


* Assist customers with configuration, user management, permissions, workflows, and platform best practices.

Strong understanding of the **Salesforce platform**, including:

* User and permission management
* Objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, workflows, and flows

* API integrations and middleware platform exposure.


* Ticket and knowledge management system experience.


* Process improvement and operational efficiency leadership.

* Owns issues end\-to\-end; drives resolution with business context awareness.


* Customer\-first mindset; builds lasting relationships.


* Continuously expands technical and pharma/life sciences business knowledge.


* Collaborates effectively across global teams; mentors colleagues.


* Proactively improves processes and drives operational excellence.


* Communicates professionally in technical and business contexts.

Our intelligent, cloud\-based platform combines technology, data, analytics, AI, and industry expertise to help leading Life Sciences organizations **optimize revenue, navigate complex regulations, improve decision\-making,** and bring life\-changing products to market faster.



Today, **150\+ leading companies** across the globe trust Model N to optimize growth and transform critical commercial processes. Our solutions manage approximately **$1\.3 trillion in gross revenue**, helping customers reduce complexity, strengthen compliance, and unlock new opportunities for growth.



At Model N, we are building the next generation of **Life Sciences revenue management**—where technology, data, AI, and human expertise come together to create meaningful business impact.

For more information, visit www.modeln.com.

title: Lead SoC validation with ARM exp
description:
Overview:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.  

Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
Responsibilities:
**SMTS SILICON VALIDATION ENGINEER**### **Position Summary**


We are seeking a highly motivated **Silicon Validation Lead** to drive end\-to\-end validation of next\-generation ARM\-based SoCs. This role requires strong hands\-on expertise in silicon bring\-up, high\-speed peripheral validation, multimedia/video IP validation, and system\-level debug. The candidate will lead a small team of engineers while owning the execution and delivery of silicon validation milestones from first silicon through production release.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own overall silicon validation strategy, planning, execution, and signoff for assigned SoC programs.
* Lead a small team of validation engineers and provide technical mentorship.
* Develop validation plans, coverage models, regression strategies, and execution metrics.
* Drive silicon bring\-up and feature validation for ARM\-based SoCs.
* Validate high\-speed interfaces including PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, SerDes, and related subsystems.
* Validate multimedia and video IPs including display, video processing, imaging, and codec subsystems.
* Develop and execute validation tests using bare\-metal and Linux environments.
* Debug complex issues spanning silicon, RTL, firmware, drivers, and operating systems.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture, Design, Verification, Software, Product Engineering, and Board teams.
* Drive production readiness, issue tracking, risk assessment, and validation signoff activities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of industry experience in silicon validation or SoC validation.
* Strong experience with ARM\-based SoC architectures.
* Hands\-on experience validating high\-speed peripheral interfaces.
* Strong experience with video, display, multimedia, or imaging IP validation.
* Solid understanding of RTL architecture and digital design fundamentals.
* Experience developing and debugging embedded software in C.
* Strong Linux development and debug experience.

title: Business & Operations Engineer
description:
We are looking for an **Business \& Operations Engineer** who can understand our business and operations and use **AI, automation, engineering, and data** to make the company work better.

Our processes are currently spread across different teams, applications, spreadsheets, CRMs, and manual workflows. We need someone who can understand how these processes work, identify what is inefficient or fragmented, and then **build, test, deploy, and maintain reliable systems that connect, automate, and improve them**.

This is a highly hands\-on role. You will work closely with the business, understand operational requirements, design solutions, build them, test them against real\-world scenarios, deploy them, maintain them, and measure their impact.

The ideal candidate is someone who can move comfortably between **business operations, data, AI, automation, integrations, software development, and production support**.

What You Will Do Business Operations \& Process Improvement

* Understand the company's business operations, workflows, and processes across different teams.
* Work directly with teams and management to understand their requirements, problems, and bottlenecks.
* Identify repetitive, manual, inefficient, and fragmented processes.
* Translate business processes and requirements into practical technology and automation solutions.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve the company's operations through technology.
* Determine which processes should remain manual, which should be automated, and which can be redesigned around AI.
* Take ownership of improving operational systems rather than simply documenting problems.

AI \& Intelligent Automation

* Identify opportunities where **AI and automation** can create meaningful improvements in the business.
* Design, prototype, test, and productionize AI\-powered and agentic workflows.
* Integrate workflows with AI platforms and LLM services.
* Build AI workflows capable of handling complex, variable, or unstructured information.
* Use AI for classification, extraction, summarization, decision support, intelligent routing, process execution, and exception handling.
* Evaluate existing automation approaches and determine where they should be enhanced, redesigned, or replaced with AI\-native or agentic solutions.
* Compare different approaches using measurable outcomes such as accuracy, reliability, time saved, cost, and business impact.

Automation, APIs \& Integrations

* Build, deploy, and maintain business process automations.
* Integrate applications and systems using **APIs, webhooks, browser\-based workflows, and custom code**.
* Build workflows using tools such as **n8n, Zapier**, and similar platforms.
* Maintain existing automation solutions by diagnosing failures and fixing issues.
* Adapt automations when dependent applications, websites, APIs, or business processes change.
* Ensure deployed automations remain reliable for the teams that depend on them.
* Build appropriate **error handling, logging, monitoring, alerts, and recovery mechanisms** into production workflows.
* Maintain clear documentation, version control, testing procedures, and change\-management practices.
* Establish reusable engineering patterns and standards for automation architecture, code quality, deployment, and support.
* Monitor automation performance, including execution volumes, errors, reliability, processing time, and time saved.

Application Development, Testing \& Production Reliability

* Build internal tools, dashboards, web applications, interfaces, scripts, and other solutions when existing software is not sufficient.
* Use **Claude Code, Codex, and other AI\-assisted coding tools** to rapidly turn business requirements into working solutions.
* Be comfortable with rapid development or **"vibe coding"**, while understanding that producing a working prototype is only the beginning.
* Take responsibility for **thoroughly testing everything you build before and after deployment**.
* Test individual features, workflows, integrations, data flows, permissions, inputs, outputs, and failure scenarios.
* Think through real\-world production scenarios rather than testing only the expected or "happy path."
* Test for incorrect or unexpected inputs, missing data, duplicate records, API failures, timeouts, system changes, partial failures, user errors, and other edge cases.
* Validate that applications and automations continue to work reliably under the conditions they will encounter in actual business operations.
* Monitor systems after deployment and proactively identify and fix reliability issues.
* Maintain and improve applications as business requirements and dependent systems change.
* Turn successful prototypes into **stable, maintainable, production\-ready systems**.

**Web development in this role is not simply about building applications or prototypes. We expect the person to have enough engineering experience to test what they build thoroughly, think through individual real\-life use cases and edge cases, identify failure modes, and ensure the application is reliable in a production environment.**

CRM \& Business Systems

* Take ownership of the company's CRM and continuously improve it.
* Maintain clean, structured, accurate, and reliable CRM data.
* Build CRM workflows, pipelines, automations, and processes based on business requirements.
* Integrate the CRM with other applications and systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve how teams use the CRM and how information flows through the business.
* Build or customize CRM functionality when existing capabilities are not sufficient.

Data \& Business Intelligence

* Bring together data from different systems and make it useful for decision\-making.
* Analyze operational, sales, customer, marketing, financial, and other business data.
* Build dashboards, reports, KPIs, and business intelligence tools.
* Provide clear and actionable insights rather than simply presenting data.
* Help management understand what is happening across the business.
* Identify trends, bottlenecks, opportunities, anomalies, and areas for improvement.
* Measure the impact of automation and operational changes using data.
* Work extensively with **Excel / Google Sheets**, SQL, databases, and other data\-analysis tools.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines **strong business understanding with strong technical and engineering ability**.

You should be able to sit with someone from the business, understand what they are doing and why, identify the underlying problem, and then figure out how technology can solve it.

You don't need to know every tool we use. What matters is that you can **learn quickly, figure things out independently, build solutions, and take responsibility for making sure those solutions actually work in production**.

You should have experience with several of the following:

* Business operations and process improvement
* AI and workflow automation
* APIs, webhooks, and system integrations
* Browser\-based automation
* n8n, Zapier, or similar automation platforms
* CRM systems
* LLM and AI platform integrations
* Agentic AI workflows
* Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding tools
* Rapid prototyping / vibe coding
* **Application testing and production deployment**
* Debugging and troubleshooting
* Python, JavaScript, or another programming language
* Web development
* SQL and databases
* Excel / Google Sheets and data analysis
* Dashboards and data visualization
* Git / version control
* Logging, monitoring, alerting, and production support

The Kind of Person We Want

We want someone who naturally asks:

**"Why are we doing this manually?"**

**"Why aren't these systems connected?"**

**"Can we automate this?"**

**"Can AI handle this?"**

**"What happens when something goes wrong?"**

**"Have we tested all the real\-world cases?"**

**"How do we know this will actually work in production?"**

You should enjoy taking messy, real\-world business problems and turning them into **simple, reliable, measurable systems**.

You should be comfortable moving from:

**Business problem → Understand the process → Analyze the data → Design the solution → Build → Test → Deploy → Monitor → Improve**

You should also understand that **building the solution is only part of the job**. Testing, reliability, maintenance, monitoring, and continuous improvement are equally important.

What Success Looks Like

When a team tells you, *"We spend three hours every day doing this manually,"* you should be able to understand the process, determine what can be automated, build the solution, test it against real\-world scenarios, deploy it, monitor it, and measure the time saved.

When an automation breaks, you should be able to diagnose the failure, fix it, understand why it happened, and make the workflow more resilient.

When two systems don't communicate, you should be able to figure out how to connect them.

When management asks, *"What's happening with this part of the business?"*, you should be able to find the data, analyze it, and provide a clear answer.

When someone says, *"Wouldn't it be great if we had a tool that did this?"*, you should be able to rapidly build a prototype, test it with actual users and real scenarios, improve it, and turn it into a reliable production system if it creates value.

Ultimately, we are looking for someone who can **understand the business, identify opportunities, build the technology to solve them, and take responsibility for ensuring what they build works reliably in the real world.**
