* Build and improve automation framework components, utilities, and tools that make test execution more reliable, scalable, and efficient.
* Translate product documentation and feature requirements into test plans, automation coverage, and targeted hands\-on validation for complex PC platform scenarios, including corner cases and obscure interactions across hardware, software, drivers, games, and system settings.
* Expose defects and constraints; isolate and debug issues to find root causes, measure code coverage, and drive code coverage enhancements.
* Write maintainable, reliable, and well\-documented Python code. Participate in peer code reviews with feedback on correctness, scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Work closely with development, QA, and leadership teams to report progress, raise risks, and improve overall product quality.


**What We Need To See**
* B.E. / B.Tech / M.S. degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of software development, test automation, or software quality engineering experience, including collaboration across global development and test teams.
* Strong programming experience in Python, including object\-oriented programming, package management, debugging, logging, error handling, and automation framework development.
* Working experience with databases and storage technologies like SQL, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch to support automation data and knowledge systems.
* Proven track record to design, build, and deploying AI/ML and agentic AI solutions to accelerate automation development and testing workflows.
* Strong familiarity with AI\-native development tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) and LLM APIs to improve engineering velocity.
* Clear understanding of LLM failure modes, including hallucination and context degradation, along with prevention methods.
* Good understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, PC architecture, drivers, hardware/software interactions, PC gaming scenarios, and solving workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, including the ability to isolate issues across automation, product code, operating systems, drivers, hardware configurations, and game/application behavior.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Extensive experience with automation based on artificial intelligence and custom agentic workflow development.
* Development experience fixing regression bugs and implementing or enabling tests for CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with GPUs, graphics drivers, gaming technologies, or NVIDIA technologies such as DLSS, Frame Generation, Reflex, CUDA, G\-Sync, or related areas.
* Solid understanding of PC gaming ecosystems, including launchers, overlays, multi\-monitor setups, display modes, input devices, performance tools, and compatibility scenarios.

Company: NeuraMach.AI

Location: Pune

About NeuraMach.AI  
NeuraMach.AI is an AI\-native engineering company building production\-grade AI platforms, agentic systems, RAG  
solutions, machine\-learning applications and intelligent digital products.

Role Overview  
We are looking for a Senior Tech Lead – AI/ML and Platform Architecture to own the technical direction and  
delivery of complex AI\-enabled platforms.  
This is a hands\-on leadership role combining platform architecture, AI/ML engineering, cloud systems, integrations  
and team management.

Key Responsibilities  
 Design scalable, multi\-tenant and multi\-region application architectures.  
 Define service boundaries, APIs, data flows and integration standards.  
 Lead the implementation of AI agents, RAG, tool calling and pre\-trained language\-model integrations.  
 Guide the development, training, testing and deployment of machine\-learning models.  
 Design model\-serving, versioning, monitoring and rollback workflows.  
 Lead cloud deployment, containerisation, CI/CD, observability and reliability practices.  
 Review critical code, database designs, infrastructure changes and technical decisions.  
 Lead backend, AI/ML, frontend, mobile, DevOps and QA engineers.  
 Translate business requirements into practical architecture and delivery plans.  
 Support client\-facing technical discussions, demonstrations and production releases.

Required Skills  
 5\+ years of relevant software, platform or AI/ML engineering experience.  
 Strong hands\-on Python and backend\-development experience.  
 Experience designing distributed systems, APIs and event\-driven architectures.  
 Strong PostgreSQL and data\-modelling knowledge.  
 Experience with Docker, cloud platforms and production deployment.  
 Practical experience with machine learning and model inference.  
 Experience with RAG, vector databases, LLM APIs and agentic workflows.  
 Understanding of multi\-tenant application security and role\-based access.  
 Proven experience leading engineers, reviewing code and owning releases.  
 Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.

Good to Have  
 PyTorch, scikit\-learn, LightGBM, ONNX or time\-series modelling experience.  
 LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP or structured tool\-integration experience.  
 Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and production observability.  
 Edge AI, IoT, telemetry or offline\-first system experience.  
 React, React Native or Flutter architecture awareness.  
 Experience with enterprise workflow, asset\-management or industrial software.

title: Associate Director - Technical Account Management
description:
**About Hevo**  

Hevo Data is a no\-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150\+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.



Over 2,000 data teams in 45\+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We’re top\-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.


**Why This Role Matters**  

Hevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.



We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post\-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.


**The Setup**


* A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* A product with 1000\+ customers but an evolving post\-sales playbook for 250\-300 accounts
* A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e\-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
* Strong executive support and buy\-in for investing in Technical Account Management
* A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category

**Responsibilities**

**Build and Own the TAM Program**


* Design and roll out Hevo\-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
* Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid\-market, self\-serve) and build the right engagement model for each
* Own net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion metrics

**Drive Customer Outcomes**


* Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
* Work with Sales on cross\-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
* Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
* Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in

**Customer Lifecycle**


* Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
* Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
* Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you

**Lead and Grow the Team**


* Hire and develop strong TAMs
* Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
* Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes

**Measure What Matters**


* Define and track operational metrics: time\-to\-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.
* Build dashboards and regular review cadences, and report key metrics to the executive team and board

**Cross\-Functional Work**


* Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
* Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
* Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
* Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics

**Invest in CS/TAM Technology**


* Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate
  


  

**Must\-Have**


* 10\+ years of overall experience, and 5\+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
* Experience with technical or developer\-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
* Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring\-revenue business
* Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
* Analytical and numbers\-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
* Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done
  


  

**Nice\-to\-Have**


* Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
* Familiarity with usage\-based or consumption\-based pricing models
* Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones

**Why Hevo?**
* We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B\+) and we’re one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product. Top\-rated on G2, with strong word\-of\-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital\-backed with strong investor support
* CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership
* Low\-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

title: FEA Engineer
description:
**Passionate people create exceptional things**

Did you know that the solutions we develop are a key part of most industries? Electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more.


We´re everywhere! Working with us means working with the latest technologies and groundbreaking, sustainable innovations. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.


Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning. Interested in being part of our team?


**Join us on our journey for a better tomorrow.**

**Job description**

We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for Finite Element Analysis (FEA) activities using MSC NASTRAN and Optistruct and support knowledge development projects. Your mission will be to support new product development for FEA activities \& assist in FEA knowledge development at Global Engineering Center India Airpower. You should have very high penchant for engineering analysis and analytical work.


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:


* You perform advanced FEA analyses for a wide range of applications and products. In close collaboration with your internal client and with the necessary creativity you translate your findings to a performant and cost\-effective design. The client is guided by you from the moment you receive the request up to the implementation of the solution.
* In all projects a customer focused approach is crucial. You are able to analyze the client’s problem and asses if he needs a simple hand calculation or a more complex FEA simulation. It is your task to select the most efficient and accurate solution strategy to tackle the job.
* Components analyzed include compressor/pump frames, rotors, housings etc. Type of analyses includes linear static, non\-linear and dynamic calculations.
* You remain up to date with the latest developments in the field of CAE/FEA Domain. You identify opportunities to improve and/or expand our calculation models and tools. And together with your colleagues you introduce these improvements in our processes worldwide and develop the Static structural and dynamic competence domain in Atlas Copco.
* Interaction with overseas Atlas Copco customers on a regular basis is required.
* Provide CAE support to customers in phase of product development and product enhancement.
* Support competence development and following best practices in CAE.
* Compliance to ISO Procedures.

**Experience requirements**

2\-4 years of FEA experience, experience on compressors/pumps is an added advantage.


**Knowledge**

* An in\-depth knowledge of FEA, Applied Mechanics, Dynamics of structure.
* Hands on experience in HyperMesh/HyperView/ Simlab /Inspire / SimSolid as pre/post\-processor and Nastran/Opti\-struct as solver are must and he/she needs to be an in dependable resource to the team in these areas.
* Should be able to perform linear, Nonlinear and dynamic analysis on 3D solid components. Experience on Pressure vessels or Power Train is essential.
* Ability to convert problem statements into FEA model strategy definition and results into solutions is essential.
* The ideal candidate shall be able to judge and interpret the analysis results in a good manner with critical attitude. Should possess FE modeling reviewing skills and quality awareness.
* Experience in the areas below is an added advantage
	+ Performing modal/frequency\-response/random\-vibration/vibration\-fatigue calculations/
	+ Experience on Rotordynamics simulations
	+ Correlation of simulation results to test particularly in the dynamics domain
	+ Experience in providing solutions to vibration problem
	+ Knowledge of standards/codes (ASCE/EN/DNV) is an added advantage
	+ Knowledge of ASME Sec. VIII Div.1/2 for strength and fatigue analysis of vessels is desired
* Experience in below programming skills is an added advantage
	+ Unix\-Shell scripts
	+ TCL/tK
	+ Python
	+ Matlab
	+ HTML
	+ AI/ Machine Learning

**Educational requirements**

M.Tech/ M.E.


**Personality requirements**

* Research attitude
* Good interpersonal skills and positive attitude.
* Dynamic and energetic.
* Good presentation, business communication and analytical skills.
* High achievement drive and willingness to accept challenges
* Customer focused.

**Recruiter**  

Shweta Shinde

title: HPC and AI Performance Engineer
description:
HPC and AI Performance Engineer  



This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**High Performance Computing, AI and Labs** is a critical element of HPE. We are focused on delivering innovative solutions that accelerate our customers’ digital transformation, enabling them to tackle their complex, and data\-intensive workloads. Combining deep expertise and the development of the world’s most cutting\-edge, high\-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight \& innovation. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.  

  

**HPE** is seeking a **High\-Performance Computing (HPC) Benchmarking Performance Engineer** to support scientific application benchmarking and performance optimization on HPE supercomputing platforms. In this role, the engineer will work with standard HPC and scientific application benchmarks to support HPE’s sales, development, and marketing initiatives. The position requires strong technical knowledge of HPC systems, performance analysis tools, and optimization techniques to help deliver optimal benchmark and application performance on HPE supercomputers deployed at customer sites worldwide. The ideal candidate will bring experience with HPC scientific applications, a solid understanding of HPC hardware and architecture, and strong collaboration and communication skills. Candidates who meet a subset of the qualifications and demonstrate a strong willingness and ability to learn are also encouraged to apply for this role.

**HPE** operates in a dynamic, fast\-paced business environment and is looking for motivated engineers who can consistently deliver the high\-quality results expected by HPE’s HPC customers. This role requires clear and independent thinking, along with the ability to apply innovative approaches to work activities and problem solving. HPE values a constructive, collaborative, and results\-oriented work style.

**What you will do:**

* Conduct scientific application performance benchmarking in a timely manner, often under tight deadlines, to support HPE sales engagements and internal product decision\-making. This includes benchmarking scientific Independent Software Vendor (ISV) applications as well as open\-source applications widely used across the HPC community.
* Optimize HPC benchmarks on HPE systems to generate performance results and insights that help HPE submit competitive proposals for customer opportunities.
* Develop and apply a strong understanding of HPC architectural components, system features, and performance estimation methodologies to assess benchmark performance on current and future HPE systems.
* Analyze benchmark results to identify performance bottlenecks across compute, memory, accelerator, interconnect, MPI, and I/O subsystems, and recommend optimization approaches for improved application performance on HPE HPC platforms.
* Stay current on HPE and competitor HPC products, along with relevant performance optimization techniques, to support delivery of high\-quality benchmark results for sales opportunities.
* Collaborate closely with colleagues across HPE and with external technical peers to achieve optimal benchmark performance on HPE platforms.
* Provide benchmarking consultation and technical guidance to Sales, Marketing, and Development teams to support business growth and customer success.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Environmental Science, or a related discipline; Master’s or PhD preferred.
* Typically **5\+ years** experience.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* **Academic** or **industry experience** in **HPC**, with a strong understanding of scientific and engineering application **benchmarks** used in the HPC market.
* **Demonstrated** ability to evaluate, tune, and optimize **computational** application **benchmark performance** on Linux\-based **HPC systems**.
* **Python, shell scripting, and other automation or scripting languages**
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to achieve defined technical, customer, and business objectives.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, benchmark results, and performance recommendations clearly to internal and external audiences.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex performance issues.
* Experience with several of the following programming models, tools, and environments, with the ability to quickly learn additional technologies as needed:
* MPI\-based **parallel programming** and runtime environments
* Compilers and programming languages such as C, C\+\+, and Fortran
* **OpenMP** and other shared\-memory parallel programming approaches
* Linux operating environments, command\-line tools, and system\-level workflows
* **Performance** profiling, tracing, analysis, and debugging tools
* Experience with, or the ability to quickly develop proficiency in, the following HPC technologies and concepts:
* Processor technologies, including **CPUs**, **GPUs**, and accelerators, from both user and programmer perspectives
* Accelerator programming technologies such as **CUDA**, **OpenACC**, and related **GPU** programming models
* Understanding of different MPI implementations and best practices for achieving optimal application performance with each
* Parallel file systems such as Lustre, GPFS, or other HPC storage technologies
* Running and scaling applications and benchmarks on large\-scale HPC systems
* Analyzing, interpreting, and assessing benchmark and application performance across different HPC architectures and system configurations
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical findings and present results clearly.
* Willingness and ability to work with leading\-edge technologies, proactively identify and resolve issues, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results under demanding deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**


Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

title: Group Manager Payments Engineering Manager – Intelligent Automation
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Overview**


Citi Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) is seeking a senior Engineering Manager to lead the development of intelligent automation solutions for Payments Operations and Client Servicing. This role sits within the Instant Payments Technology organization and is responsible for leading a team of software engineers while providing strong technical leadership in the design, development, and delivery of AI\-enabled platforms and applications.


The successful candidate will combine proven engineering management experience with hands\-on technical expertise and a track record of building and deploying enterprise\-scale automation solutions into production. This individual will lead engineers, influence technical direction, and actively participate in architecture and implementation decisions while delivering scalable solutions leveraging Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, document intelligence, workflow orchestration, and cloud\-native technologies.


This role requires a leader who can operate effectively at both strategic and technical levels, partnering closely with Payments Operations, Product, and Technology teams to identify automation opportunities and translate business needs into scalable software solutions. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated history of leading high\-performing engineering teams, delivering distributed systems using modern Java technologies, and applying AI capabilities to solve complex operational challenges in large\-scale enterprise environments.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of software engineers responsible for delivering intelligent automation solutions for Payments Operations and Client Servicing.
* Own end\-to\-end engineering delivery, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment, production support, and operational excellence.
* Define and execute the engineering roadmap for AI\-enabled workflow automation solutions aligned with Payments Technology objectives and business priorities.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership by actively participating in architecture reviews, solution design, technology selection, engineering reviews, and key technical decisions.
* Design, build, and deliver scalable software solutions leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, document intelligence, workflow orchestration, and automation technologies.
* Partner closely with Payments Operations, Product, Architecture, and Technology teams to identify high\-value automation opportunities and translate business requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including cloud\-native architectures, microservices, event\-driven systems, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and platform engineering principles.
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for quality, scalability, resiliency, observability, security, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Ensure all solutions comply with enterprise technology standards, AI governance requirements, regulatory expectations, cybersecurity controls, and risk management policies.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and technical excellence through mentoring, talent development, performance management, and hiring.

**Required Qualifications**


* 15\+ years of software engineering experience delivering large\-scale enterprise applications, platforms, and distributed systems.
* 5\+ years of experience leading software engineering teams, including management of globally distributed engineering organizations.
* Proven hands\-on experience designing, building, and deploying Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, intelligent automation, workflow automation, or document intelligence solutions into production environments with measurable business impact.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams while remaining actively engaged in architecture, technical design, software delivery, and engineering execution.
* Deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, API development, and distributed systems design.
* Strong experience with event\-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud\-native applications utilizing Kubernetes, OpenShift, containers, and modern DevOps practices.
* Strong understanding of AI architecture patterns including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, AI agents, tool integration, workflow automation, and human\-in\-the\-loop processes.
* Demonstrated ability to drive engineering execution while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, security, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with experience collaborating with senior business and technology leaders in highly regulated environments.

**Why Join Citi**


Join a team shaping the future of global money movement and real\-time payments. You'll have the opportunity to build cloud\-native payment infrastructure at global scale, solve complex low\-latency distributed systems challenges, influence the evolution of instant payments worldwide, and leverage AI\-powered engineering capabilities to deliver the next generation of payment innovation.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

The ideal candidate will have a solid background in machine learning along with hands‑on expertise in LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and Agentic AI frameworks such as CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, or LangChain Agents.

* **Role: Agentic AI Engineer**
* **Location: All Persistent Location**

* Design and implement RAG pipelines, vector search solutions, and embedding‑based retrieval systems.

Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to define use cases and convert them into production‑ready GenAI solutions.
* Implement hallucination reduction, prompt‑engineering strategies, and model evaluation methods.
* Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, and automation workflows.  

Work with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate) for semantic search.  

Monitor, evaluate, and optimize GenAI models for accuracy, performance, and cost.

* 5\+ years of experience in AI/ML, including model development, data preprocessing, EDA, training, and evaluation.
* 2\+ years of hands‑on experience in Generative AI (LLMs, embeddings, RAG, LLM‑based apps).
* 6\+ months of hands‑on experience with Agentic AI frameworks (CrewAI / AutoGen / LangGraph / LangChain Agents).
* Strong proficiency in Python and ML libraries (Scikit‑learn, Pandas, NumPy).
* Experience with OpenAI APIs, Azure OpenAI, HuggingFace, and prompt engineering.
* Familiarity with building scalable APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Hands‑on knowledge of cloud services (Azure/AWS/GCP) for AI deployment.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and integration patterns.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and model deployment best practice.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**About Gravitee**

Since 2015, Gravitee has grown into a global force, recognized as a 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for API Management. What started with four developers challenging the complexities of APIs has evolved into a revolutionary platform powering API and event stream ecosystems worldwide. We drive digital transformation for top enterprises \- from Michelin to Roche to Blue Yonder \- offering unmatched control over APIs and event streams.


Now, we are leading the next evolution: AI Agent Management. Join us on this journey. Be part of a team that is redefining what is possible in API management, and shaping the future of digital transformation. The possibilities are endless \- be a part of the revolution!

**The Role \& Why It Exists**

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of a Platform Team dedicated to making Gravitee's products best in class in terms of both product and infrastructure. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers Gravitee's platform, while also supporting our customers with exceptional technical expertise.


This is a hands\-on, critical role in our organization. The right candidate will enjoy problem solving in a highly specialized and technical way \- from delivering production\-ready Kubernetes\-based environments to investigating complex customer issues.


As Gravitee expands into AI Agent Management, the Platform team plays a critical role in ensuring our infrastructure can support AI workloads, agent orchestration, and the demanding performance requirements of real\-time AI gateway operations.

**What You Will Be Doing**
--------------------------


Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* Participate in delivering Gravitee NextGen Cloud infrastructure, including environments that support AI Gateway and Agent Management workloads
* Deliver production\-ready, Kubernetes\-based, customer\-facing environments \- not just POCs
* Assist the support team to help customers have the best experience possible with our products
* Work with other team members to develop and maintain new infrastructure features
* Share your knowledge (tech and non\-tech) during internal Gravitee TechTalks
* Lead investigation of support tickets and work collaboratively to resolve customer issues

* Be innovative within the team to help improve processes and tools, including exploring AI\-driven automation for operations

* Be open and proactive in using AI\-assisted tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, troubleshooting aids, automation helpers) to accelerate day\-to\-day work
* Use AI thoughtfully to improve existing processes, reduce manual toil, and increase reliability in operations and support workflows
* Experiment with AI\-driven approaches to problem solving, documentation, and incident analysis, while maintaining a strong critical mindset
* Understand the limits of AI tools and apply engineering judgment to validate, refine, and productionize outcomes
* Contribute ideas on how AI can be safely and effectively integrated into our platform, infrastructure, and internal tooling


AI at Gravitee is not about shortcuts \- it is about working smarter, faster, and more sustainably at scale.

**Essential Skills**
--------------------


The right candidate will possess at least the following skills:

* 5\+ years of professional experience in infrastructure management
* Fluency with creating and managing Kubernetes clusters and Helm\-based deployments
* Strong understanding of infrastructure and deployment automation
* Experience with Terraform, Docker, and certificate management (ZeroSSL, Let's Encrypt)
* Experience with continuous delivery tools (Argo Workflows, ArgoCD, Helm Charts)
* Cloud platform experience (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus)
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning
* Patient, resilient problem\-solver with great attention to detail

**Desired Skills**
------------------


Additionally, these skills are not required but preferable:

* Experience with API Management or Identity and Access Management platforms
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements and GPU workload orchestration
* Experience supporting AI Gateway or LLM\-serving infrastructure
* Knowledge of networking, service mesh, and traffic management patterns

**Core Values**
---------------


At Gravitee, we believe strongly in living our core values as a team and as a company. We do not just write them \- we live them:

* Passion: We bring excitement to everything we do, constantly innovating to stay ahead of the curve.
* Hold Nothing Back: We go above and beyond to help customers and teammates succeed, holding ourselves to the highest standards.
* Professionalism: We believe in clear, respectful communication and prioritize the needs of our team and customers.

**At Gravitee, You'll Get...**
------------------------------

* Pension and 401k program options for all locations

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer \- Inference \& Optimization \|\| Altera Institute \- Digiaccel Learning** 




  





**Note: Please share a link to a project, GitHub repository, technical blog, paper, demo, or other proof of work where you have worked hands\-on with LLM fine\-tuning, inference optimization, model evaluation, or GPU optimization. Briefly describe your contribution.** 




  





 At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to redefine management education for the digital and AI\-first world. We are building technology that powers transformative learning experiences for thousands of learners across India. From learner journeys and assessments to AI enabled learning experiences and internal platforms, our engineering team plays a critical role in shaping the future of education.
 



  





 As an AI Engineer \- LLM Inference \& Optimization, you will work on building and optimizing real time Voice AI systems that power next\-generation learning experiences. You will work directly with large language models, inference systems, evaluation frameworks and GPU infrastructure to improve model accuracy, latency, throughput and cost in production environments.
 



  





 This is not an LLM wrapper or prompt\-engineering role. This role is ideal for someone who understands how LLMs work under the hood, enjoys experimenting with models, measures performance rigorously and knows how to make models faster, smaller, and more reliable for production workloads.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**LLM Fine\-Tuning \& Model Engineering** 




 • Fine\-tune LLMs for production use cases using LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, full fine tuning, distillation, or similar techniques.
 



 • Fine\-tune and distill smaller, faster models for narrow and repeated reasoning, classification, judgment, and other production tasks.
 



 • Experiment with different model architectures, training approaches, datasets, and hyperparameters to improve model performance.
 



 • Combine code and LLMs to build consistent, reliable, and production\-ready AI systems.
 



 • Analyse model behaviour and identify opportunities to improve accuracy, reliability, and consistency.
 



  





**Inference Optimization \& Performance** 




 • Optimize LLM inference using quantization, batching, caching, streaming generation, and other performance optimization techniques.
 



 • Work with GPU inference systems and optimize KV cache, GPU memory utilization, batching, and compute efficiency.
 



 • Own model latency as a core engineering metric, including TTFT, p50/p95 latency, throughput, and tail latency.
 



 • Optimize inference specifically for real\-time Voice AI, where even a few hundred milliseconds can materially impact the quality of the conversation.
 



 • Evaluate and optimize inference frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM, or similar technologies.
 



 • Identify performance bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve system responsiveness, scalability, and cost efficiency.
 



  





**Evaluation, Benchmarking \& Experimentation** 




 • Build and maintain robust LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems for production models.
 



 • Curate evaluation datasets and design meaningful metrics to measure model quality and task performance.
 



 • Run structured experiments across different model variants and fine\-tuning approaches.
 



 • Build regression testing frameworks to ensure model improvements do not introduce unexpected performance or quality degradation.
 



 • Perform statistical comparisons between model variants and use data to guide model selection.
 



 • Benchmark and evaluate trade\-offs across accuracy, latency, model size, throughput, memory usage and cost.
 



  





**Production AI Engineering** 




 • Take ownership of AI models and inference systems from experimentation through production deployment and continuous optimization.
 



 • Monitor production model performance and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
 



 • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams to translate business problems into reliable AI solutions.
 



 • Build systems that balance model intelligence with the practical requirements of speed, consistency, scalability, and cost.
 



 • Contribute towards establishing an engineering discipline around model accuracy and latency across the AI platform.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 3\-5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, deep learning, LLM engineering, or a closely related field..
 



 • Strong programming skills in Python and hands\-on experience with PyTorch and/or Hugging Face Transformers.
 



 • Hands\-on experience working with LLMs beyond API integration or prompt engineering.
 



 • Practical experience with one or more of LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, fine\-tuning, or model distillation.
 



 • Strong understanding of LLM inference, GPU computation, KV cache, batching, and memory optimization.
 



 • Experience with quantization and inference optimization techniques.
 



 • Exposure to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM, or similar inference frameworks.
 



 • Understanding of LLM evaluation, benchmarking, dataset curation, and model experimentation.
 



 • Experience with low\-latency or streaming inference systems is highly desirable.
 



 • Strong understanding of the trade\-offs between accuracy, latency, throughput, model size, memory, and cost.
 



 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an experimental and data\-driven approach to engineering.
 



 • Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex technical problems, and operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 •
 **Build Real\-Time AI Systems \-** 
 Work on production\-grade Voice AI systems where model quality and latency directly impact the user experience.
 



 •
 **Work Beyond Prompt Engineering \-** 
 Get hands\-on exposure to model fine tuning, inference optimization, evaluation, GPU systems, and model performance.
 



 •
 **Solve Challenging AI Problems \-** 
 Work on problems involving model accuracy, latency, scalability, memory, throughput, and cost.
 



 •
 **End\-to\-End Ownership \-** 
 Contribute across the complete AI lifecycle, from experimentation and fine\-tuning to evaluation, optimization, and production inference.
 



 •
 **High\-Growth Environment \-** 
 Be part of a fast\-scaling organization that values innovation, speed, intellectual honesty, and engineering excellence.
 



 •
 **Continuous Learning \-** 
 Work closely with experienced product and engineering leaders while building expertise in rapidly evolving AI technologies.
 



 •
 **Meaningful Impact \-** 
 Build AI systems that power learning experiences and impact the careers and learning journeys of thousands of professionals.
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.
 



  





 Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher\-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.
 



  





 With a learner\-centric philosophy, industry\-driven curriculum, experiential learning opportunities, and deep engagement with corporate leaders, Altera equips learners with the skills, capabilities, and mindset required to thrive in today's rapidly evolving business landscape.
 



  





 We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome\-oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.
 



  





 We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

description:
**AI R\&D; Lead / Founder's AI Right Hand** 




  





**Help the founder explore, prototype and define what DigeeSell should build in AI.** 




 Location: Hybrid \| Gurgaon
 



  





**About the Role** 




 DigeeSell is entering AI products and solutions, but we are intentionally not pretending we already know the final product. We want a high\-agency person who can work directly with the founder to explore, prototype, break, rebuild and discover what is possible. You will sit between product thinking, AI research, technical architecture and rapid execution.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





 • Work closely with the founder on new AI ideas, experiments and product directions.
 



 • Turn vague ideas into testable hypotheses, prototypes, workflows and technical decisions.
 



 • Understand the architecture and technology behind AI systems, even when you are not writing every line of production code yourself.
 



 • Use AI coding/building tools such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw or comparable tools to rapidly create real working systems.
 



 • Explore agents, agentic workflows, tool use, memory, RAG, multi\-agent systems and emerging AI products.
 



 • Test new AI models and tools hands\-on rather than relying on marketing claims.
 



 • Develop intuition for what models are good and bad at, when outputs can be trusted, and where verification is needed.
 



 • Debug ambiguous problems by moving from symptom fi hypothesis fi test fi evidence fi solution.
 



 • Run cheap experiments first and hunt for 2×–10× improvements in speed, cost or outcome.
 



 • Help define architecture, stack and roadmap once a promising direction is discovered.
 



 • Document learnings and help train future hires. What You Need to Be Good At
 



 • Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, databases and AI/LLM systems.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with generative AI and agentic systems.
 



 • Exceptional ability to use AI coding tools to build prototypes quickly.
 



 • Strong problem\-solving and debugging ability with incomplete information.
 



 • Excellent AI intuition around prompting, tool use, evaluation and failure modes.
 



 • High experimentation velocity and curiosity about new tools.
 



 • Founder/startup mindset: ownership, speed and resourcefulness.
 



 • Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 • Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or another modern language.
 



 • LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar.
 



 • MCP, RAG, vector databases, APIs and automation platforms.
 



 • Reinforcement learning, evaluation systems or self\-improving AI environments.
 



 • Previous 0fi1 startup, R\&D;, product or technical founder experience.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





 • Ship meaningful prototypes quickly.
 



 • Create a repeatable system for evaluating AI ideas and tools.
 



 • Help identify which AI opportunities deserve deeper investment.
 



 • Establish the technical foundation for the first product direction.
 



 • Become the founder's trusted partner for turning 'what if we tried this?' into something real.
 



  





**Who Should NOT Apply** 




 • Do not apply if you only know AI terminology but cannot demonstrate practical work.
 



 • Do not apply if you need a fully defined specification before starting.
 



 • Do not apply if you dislike breaking things, testing weird ideas or changing direction.
 



 • Do not apply if you expect AI tools to replace your own judgement.
 



  





**Practical Hiring Challenge** 




  





 Give us an ambiguous business problem. In 48–72 hours, use AI tools to research it, form a hypothesis, build a small working prototype and record a short walkthrough explaining what worked, what failed and what you would test next.
 



  





**Interview Focus** 




  





 We will evaluate practical judgement, speed of learning, quality of thinking, ability to work with ambiguity, AI\-tool fluency, problem\-solving and evidence of execution. A polished CV alone will not be enough.
 



  





**About DigeeSell** 




  





 DigeeSell Media Solutions Pvt Ltd is a Gurgaon\-based digital marketing company working across Digital Marketing, AI Automation, Branding and Web Development. We are building a new AI product and solutions capability and want people excited by the opportunity to help define it.

title: AI Engineer Senior Manager, Agent Workforce
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As the Technical Lead for Agentic Automation within Tech@BCG, you will define the technical direction for an enterprise AI platform that shifts common, repeatable tasks across Tech@BCG — spanning Change \& Communications, User Research \& Design, Enterprise Architecture, and other business\-facing functions — onto a non\-human, AI\-driven workforce. You will design, build, and fine\-tune the AI models and agent systems that power this workforce — including retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation frameworks for model quality and safety — while working in close partnership with Product Management and engineering leaders to identify which tasks are best suited for automation and translate that judgment into production\-grade agents, built on practices such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and event\-driven architectures, that improve throughput, consistency, and quality across the function.
   

  

 You will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture, establishing engineering standards, guiding implementation decisions, and mentoring engineers while driving the evolution from event\-driven AI capabilities toward increasingly autonomous, multi\-agent systems capable of owning end\-to\-end workflows with minimal human intervention. You will lead architecture reviews, evaluate emerging AI technologies, and ensure agentic systems are secure, resilient, observable, and aligned with enterprise architecture, governance, and Responsible AI principles — balancing the pace of automation with enterprise\-grade reliability, oversight, and operational excellence.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline (must have); relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership designing and delivering enterprise\-scale software platforms (must have).

Position Summary

As a Service Desk Engineer, you will be responsible for resolving customer issues across our CCaaS platform, Voice AI Hub, and ServiceNow integrations.

You will use AI\-assisted tools, CLI\-based investigation, logs, IVR traces, APIs, and automation scripts to identify root causes and resolve technical issues. We value **technical aptitude, troubleshooting ability, curiosity, and demonstrated skills** over simply the number of years of experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and resolve customer support tickets across the CCaaS platform, Voice AI Hub, and ServiceNow integrations while meeting SLA and quality targets.

* Analyze and validate AI\-generated troubleshooting and triage recommendations against actual logs, traces, configurations, and other technical evidence.
* Identify incorrect or incomplete AI analysis and provide appropriate feedback.

* Reproduce technical issues and perform structured root\-cause analysis.
* Develop automation scripts using **Python or Bash** to improve investigation workflows and eliminate repetitive tasks.
* Enrich support tickets with relevant technical findings and evidence.

* Collaborate with TAMs and other internal teams to support enterprise customers.

Required Qualifications \& Technical Skills

* B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical mindset with the ability to form hypotheses, gather evidence, and systematically isolate root causes.
* Practical experience using **AI tools for technical troubleshooting and investigation**.
* Ability to write effective prompts, iterate on AI\-generated results, and identify hallucinations or incomplete/incorrect AI responses.
* Comfortable working with the command line/terminal.
* Good understanding of log analysis and filtering using tools such as **grep, jq, and regular expressions**.
* Hands\-on experience working with **JSON and APIs**.
* Basic\-to\-intermediate scripting skills in **Python or Bash**.
* Strong customer\-service orientation and ability to remain composed under pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to participate in customer troubleshooting calls and communicate technical findings clearly.

Good to Have

* Understanding of LLM concepts, prompting techniques, context windows, hallucination/failure modes, and agentic tool usage.
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as **Grafana, CloudWatch, or log aggregation platforms**.
* Knowledge of **SQL**.
* Experience working with CCaaS, Voice AI, conversational AI, or enterprise support platforms.

title: Netscope Proxy L3
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Infrastructure Architects are the key link between Kyndryl and our clients. You’re in a technical leadership role, uniting and guiding stakeholders from clients, governance, and project executives to delivery and sometimes even the vendors who work with the client. You’ll be there from the start of a project — understanding what’s needed and figuring out the best technical solution. And you’ll be there at the finish, delivering the right product on time and within budget.
  

  

As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  

  

At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre\-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities.The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  

  

Your future at Kyndryl
  

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

Required Technical and Professional Experience


* Provide L3 technical support for complex Netskope incidents and service requests.
* Administer and troubleshoot Netskope Security Cloud policies and configurations.
* Manage Netskope Client deployment, configuration and troubleshooting.
* Configure and troubleshoot Secure Web Gateway (SWG) policies.
* Manage CASB controls, cloud application discovery and risk assessment.
* Configure and troubleshoot DLP policies, incidents and exceptions.
* Work on Netskope Private Access (NPA/ZTNA) and troubleshoot private application connectivity.
* Manage steering configurations, including client\-based and network\-based steering.
* Troubleshoot traffic forwarding, SSL inspection, PAC files, certificates and authentication issues.
* Investigate security incidents using Netskope logs, alerts and dashboards.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes.
* Integrate Netskope with SIEM, IdP/SSO, Active Directory/Entra ID and endpoint security platforms.
* Troubleshoot authentication issues involving SAML, MFA and identity providers.

  

  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience with Netskope.
* SWG, CASB and DLP.
* Netskope Client and steering configuration.
* NPA/ZTNA.
* Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS and Proxy.
* SSL/TLS and certificate troubleshooting.
* SSO/SAML/Identity concepts.
* Windows/Endpoint troubleshooting.
* SIEM and security monitoring.
* Incident, problem and change management.
* Strong RCA and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Preferred Certifications**
============================

* Netskope Certified Cloud Security Integrator / Administrator or relevant Netskope certification.
* Security\+ / CISSP / CISM.
* CCNA/CCNP.
* Microsoft security/identity certifications.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Advertisers 2nd level support team leader
description:
**Realize your potential by joining the leading performance\-driven advertising company!**



As a Team Lead for the Level 2 Advertiser Support team, you will be a driving force behind our Level 2 Advertiser Support team — leading, coaching, and developing a group of technical support engineers to deliver best\-in\-class support to our advertisers. You will balance people leadership with hands\-on technical guidance, helping your team investigate and resolve complex technical issues, and providing consultation when a case needs an expert eye.



You will act as the critical bridge between Level 1 and Level 3, coordinating with Product, Level 3 and R\&D on technical issues and incidents. You will own and drive our AI initiatives and shift\-left strategy, continuously raising the technical capabilities and knowledge of your team. You will also stay closely aligned with new product changes and shifts in the industry — and make sure your team is too.


**To thrive in this role, you'll need:**


* 5\+ years of experience in a leadership role, managing, coaching, and developing a team.
* Hands\-on Performance Management experience.
* Relevant experience in technical support, with a strong track record of solving complex, technical issues.
* Experience in auditing and quality assurance (QA).
* Advanced knowledge of SQL, APIs, Kibana, and Grafana.
* Proven ability to mentor and consult engineers through complex technical investigations, and to raise the technical bar of a team.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with a structured approach to diagnosing issues and incidents.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — for technical consultations, training material, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with Product, R\&D, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Experience working with Global Stakeholders.
* A proactive, improvement\-driven mindset — comfortable driving initiatives such as shift\-left and AI adoption within a support organization.


**Bonus points if you have:**


* Experience in digital marketing / ad\-tech — an advantage.


**How you'll make an impact:**


* Manage and lead the Level 2 Advertiser Support team, helping and guiding engineers to solve complex technical issues.
* Provide hands\-on technical consultation to team members on challenging cases.
* Act as the bridge between Level 1 to Level 2 \& Level 2 to Level 3, ensuring technical issues and incidents are escalated, tracked, and resolved smoothly.
* Coordinate with the Product, R\&D and Level 3 Support team on technical issues, bug prioritization, and incidents.
* Manage and lead AI initiatives within the team, driving adoption of AI tools to improve efficiency and support quality.
* Drive shift\-left efforts, enabling issues to be resolved earlier and more efficiently at the appropriate support level.
* Enhance the team's knowledge base and overall technical capabilities through training, mentorship, and knowledge\-sharing.
* Stay closely aligned and informed on new product changes and industry shifts, and ensure the team is kept up to date.
* Identify gaps in work methodologies, supportability, or manual work that can be improved through automation or refined processes, and work towards closing them.
* Analyse the data, KPIs and plan actions to improve it further.
* Keep the management informed about any critical ongoing incidents and any issues related to the team's performance.


**Why Taboola?**



If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they'll tell you that they've been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They'll also share more about:


* **Leadership \& Growth:** This is a role that mixes people leadership with advanced technical problem\-solving. If you're looking to grow as a leader while staying close to hands\-on technical work, then this is what you're looking for.
* **Innovation:** Drive AI initiatives and shift\-left efforts while continuously raising the technical capabilities and knowledge of the team.
* **Well\-being:** Enjoy comprehensive benefits, a fully stocked kitchen, and various gym partnerships.
* **Flexibility:** We offer a hybrid work environment with flexibility to support collaboration and productivity.
* **Work with some of the biggest names:** Taboola is an active company with a growing portfolio of features and collaborations, working with some of the biggest names in the business.


**Ready to realize your potential?**



Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.



Learn more about \#TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, \& the Taboola Life Blog.


**About Taboola**



Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.



Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola's powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola's technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

title: Senior Specialist - Development
description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

  

**Job Description:**

**Are you ready to shine?**

*At Sun Life, we empower you to be your most brilliant self.*

**Who we are?**

**Sun Life** is a leading financial services company with 157 years of history that helps our clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.


We serve millions in Canada, the U.S., Asia, the U.K., and other parts of the world. We have a network of Sun Life advisors, third\-party partners, and other distributors. Through them, we’re helping set our clients free to live their lives their way, from now through retirement. We’re working hard to support their wellness and health management goals, too. That way, they can enjoy what matters most to them. And that’s anything from running a marathon to helping their grandchildren learn to ride a bike.


To do this, we offer a broad range of protection and wealth products and services to individuals, businesses, and institutions, including:


* **Insurance.** Life, health, wellness, disability, critical illness, stop\-loss, and long\-term care insurance
* **Investments.** Mutual funds, segregated funds, annuities, and guaranteed investment products
* **Advice.** Financial planning and retirement planning services
* **Asset management.** Pooled funds, institutional portfolios, and pension funds

With innovative technology, a strong distribution network and long\-standing relationships with some of the world’s largest employers, we are today providing financial security to millions of people globally.


Sun Life is a leading financial services company that helps our clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives, with strong insurance, asset management, investments, and financial advice portfolios. At Sun Life, our asset management business draws on the talent and experience of professionals from around the globe.


**SLGS (Sun Life Global Solutions)** provides Technology and Business Services to Sun Life businesses globally. Started in 2006, since then SLGS has achieved scale, growth, and operational maturity. We’ve also institutionalized Sun Life's global standards by integrating closely with their corporate functions. Asia Service Centers today has more than 1100 Engineers, 200\+ AWS professionals, and a group of Certified Actuaries. They deliver various complex business solutions. The current workforce comprises of 75% Gen Y. We’re proud to be a young, bustling organization.


The SLGS core digital competencies are cloud, mobile, data analytics, visualization, and RPA. In the past three years, we have launched over 20 digital assets, including the Sun Life Mobile Application, Conversational AI bots and many cutting\-edge solutions. We’ve evolved our capability in information technology, business processing, investment research, and enterprise infrastructure to Sun Life businesses around the globe. Digital transformation, for us, is not just about technological advancement and application, but also about enabling business strategy. It's about building new business models, enhancing operational and value\-chain efficiency, and creating best\-in\-class experiences. It’s also about building a digital culture and mindset. We enable all this with the latest technologies, data\-driven insights, skillsets, talent and change frameworks.


We are constantly **expanding** our **strength in Information technology** and are looking for fresh talents who can bring ideas and values aligning with our Digital strategy.


Our Client Impact strategy is motivated by the need to create an inclusive culture, empowered by highly engaged people. We are entering a new world that focuses on doing purpose driven work. The kind that fills your day with excitement and determination, because when you love what you do, it never feels like work. We want to create an environment where you feel empowered to take action and are surrounded by people who challenge you, support you and inspire you to become the best version of yourself. As an employer, we not only want to attract top talent, but we want you to have the best Sun Life Experience.


**We strive to Shine Together; Make Life Brighter \& Shape the Future!**
