title: Senior AI Engineer — Applied AI / ML (Potential Contract to Hire)
description:
Location India, Pune preferred
   

  

 Stay close to the code. Get closer to the decisions.
   

  

 SureHost is an early\-stage hospitality technology company building new ways for short\-term rental operators to run and grow their businesses.
   

  

 Our technical and AI team is based in Pune. Our customer and product team is based in Des Moines, Iowa. We are building the company across both.
   

  

 Pune is not a downstream engineering center at SureHost. Our India\-based technical leaders are company owners and help shape our architecture, technical direction, and strategy.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who wants meaningful technical ownership without moving away from the work.
   

  

 This is an individual\-builder role.
   

  

 You will work directly with our CTO and AI/architecture leadership to design systems, write production code, evaluate models, work through difficult failure modes, and make technical decisions while the product and architecture are still taking shape.
   

  

 The hard part starts after the prototype works.
   

  

 SureHost is applying AI to real customer problems across video and image analysis, multimodal models, LLMs, agents, data, and workflow automation.
   

  

 A successful demo is only the beginning.
   

  

 The work includes deciding whether the system is accurate enough, fast enough, reliable enough, and economical enough to hold up when customers depend on it.
   

  

**You Will**
* Design and build production AI/ML systems using Python
* Work across LLMs, computer vision, multimodal models, and agentic workflows
* Evaluate when to use proprietary model APIs, open\-source models, adaptation, or a different technical approach
* Design evaluation systems around accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and known failure modes
* Build data pipelines, APIs, backend services, and the surrounding systems required to put AI into production
* Own systems from experimentation through deployment, monitoring, debugging, and iteration
* Work directly with technical leadership on architecture and technical tradeoffs
* Get close enough to customer and product problems to challenge requirements when a better technical answer exists
* Improve testing, observability, documentation, and production reliability
* Review code and help less\-experienced engineers work through difficult technical problems


 Your primary job is still to build.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

 This role is likely a fit for someone with 5–8\+ years of software engineering experience and meaningful recent work building AI/ML systems.
   

  

 You should bring strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, experience deploying AI into production, and enough depth to reason about the entire system around the model.
   

  

 That may include experience with LLMs, multimodal models, computer vision, agents, model APIs, open\-source models, evaluation systems, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and backend services.
   

  

 More important than checking every box is evidence of technical judgment.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can work through questions such as:
   

  

 Is the model actually good enough for the customer problem?
   

  

 Where will it fail?
   

  

 Should we change the prompt, the data, the model, the architecture, or the requirement?
   

  

 What belongs in AI and what should remain deterministic software?
   

  

 What happens to reliability, latency, and cost when this reaches production?
   

  

 Early\-stage experience, video or computer\-vision work, workflow automation, or hospitality technology is useful but not required.
   

  

 Why this role is different
   

  

 At many companies, becoming more senior means getting farther from the actual system.
   

  

 That is not the path here.
   

  

 SureHost needs experienced builders who want to remain close to the code while participating more deeply in architecture, product questions, customer discovery, and technical decision\-making.
   

  

 There are very few layers between a customer problem and the people deciding what gets built.
   

  

 The architecture is still forming.
   

  

 The product is still teaching us things.
   

  

 A senior engineer at this stage has room to influence both.
   

  

 What you’re joining
   

  

 SureHost is working with its first paid customer pilot and preparing for broader U.S. expansion.
   

  

 The technical organization is led across Pune and the U.S. by experienced leaders with complementary strengths in AI, architecture, product, and broad technology leadership.
   

  

 You will build under that leadership—not underneath a distant chain of decisions.
   

  

 You will have people to learn from, difficult problems to own, and enough proximity to the business to understand why the system exists in the first place.
   

  

 The role begins as a full\-time contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into a full\-time employee role as SureHost grows.
   

  

 Build with us

title: AI Engineer, Applied AI / ML, (Potential Contract to Hire)
description:
**Pune, India Preferred**
****Full\-time contractor, with potential to transition to FTE****
 Build close to the problem. Learn the whole system.
   

  

 SureHost is an early\-stage hospitality technology company building new ways for short\-term rental operators to run and grow their businesses.
   

  

 Our technical and AI team is based in Pune. Our customer and product team is based in Des Moines, Iowa. We are building the company across both.
   

  

 Pune is not a downstream engineering center at SureHost. Our India\-based technical leaders are company owners and help shape our architecture, technical direction, and strategy.
   

  

 We are looking for an AI Engineer who already knows how to build and wants to develop a much broader technical range.
   

  

 You will work directly with two experienced technical leaders—one with deep AI and architecture expertise and one with broad CTO\-level engineering experience—while building systems being shaped by our first paying customers.
   

  

 This is an individual\-builder role.
   

  

 You will write code. You will ship systems. You will also get close to the customer problems, product decisions, architecture, and technical tradeoffs behind what gets built.
   

  

 What you’ll build
   

  

 Our AI work spans video and image analysis, multimodal models, LLMs, agents, evaluation, data, and the services that connect those systems to the product.
   

  

**You Will**
* Build and improve AI/ML systems using Python
* Implement and test LLM, computer\-vision, multimodal, and agentic workflows
* Evaluate and integrate open\-source models and third\-party AI APIs
* Create datasets, evaluation pipelines, and automated tests
* Analyze model outputs and find where accuracy or reliability breaks down
* Build data\-processing pipelines, APIs, and backend services
* Take experiments that work in a demo and make them hold up inside a real product
* Debug production problems and improve latency, reliability, and cost
* Work directly with technical leadership as architecture and product decisions are made
* Learn how customer problems become requirements and technical decisions
* Take increasing ownership of systems from initial problem through production


 Requirements will change as we learn from customers.
   

  

 Part of the job is understanding what changed, why it matters, and what should happen next.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

**This Role Is Likely a Fit For Someone With**
* 2–5 years of software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI experience
* Strong Python development skills
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks and APIs
* Experience with LLMs, computer vision, or multimodal AI
* Working knowledge of APIs, databases, Git, testing, and cloud environments
* Experience turning prototypes into maintainable software
* A systematic approach to evaluating AI output—not just deciding whether a demo looks good
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills
* Curiosity about the customer and business problem behind the technical work
* The desire to own more than one narrow layer of a system


 Experience deploying AI applications, building agents, working with video or multimodal models, or contributing to production ML systems is a plus.
   

  

 A different path for an engineer
   

  

 The goal is not simply to get better at implementing AI features.
   

  

 It is to develop the judgment to understand what should be built, how the system should be designed, what tradeoffs matter, how it behaves in production, and whether it solves the customer's actual problem.
   

  

 That happens by staying close to the work.
   

  

 At SureHost, engineers can move between experimentation, architecture, product questions, production problems, and customer learning because there are very few layers separating them.
   

  

 You will still be an individual builder.
   

  

 You will simply get to see—and increasingly own—more of the system around what you build.
   

  

 What you’re joining
   

  

 SureHost is working with its first paid customer pilot and preparing for broader U.S. expansion.
   

  

 That means much of the product still has to be figured out.
   

  

 For the right engineer, that is the opportunity.
   

  

 There is no large organization deciding everything upstream and handing implementation downstream. The Pune and U.S. teams work together around the same customer problems and product.
   

  

 This role begins as a full\-time contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into a full\-time employee role as SureHost grows.
   

  

 Build with us
   

  

 If the goal is to stay inside one narrow technical lane, there are easier places to do that.
   

  

 If the goal is to understand more of the problem, more of the system, and more of the decisions behind what gets built, we should talk.

**About the Role** 




  





 We are expanding our AI team to build, scale and enhance our production\-grade AI systems. As an AI Engineer, you will work across the full spectrum of AI — traditional ML, NLP, LLM\-powered applications, conversational AI, multimodal AI (text, audio, video), agentic architectures, and evolving AI use cases — with a strong focus on Azure\-based deployment. This role is about applying and integrating AI technologies into enterprise solutions and workflows, driving efficiency, automation, and actionable insights across business functions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, build, and deploy AI/ML models and applications on Azure (Azure ML, Cognitive Services, AKS, Functions).
* Develop and integrate LLM\-powered applications (Azure OpenAI, GPT\-based APIs, Hugging Face models).
* Build and deploy chatbot and conversational AI systems for enterprise productivity, knowledge and information management.
* Develop traditional ML models (classification, prediction, recommendation) and combine them with LLM/NLP workflows.
* Architect and implement agentic AI systems and orchestration workflows.
* Work with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, Qdrant) for retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG).
* Explore and implement emerging AI use cases such as video analytics, emotion/sentiment analysis, and ranking systems.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications and platforms (ERP, CRM, ITSM, HR systems).
* Build and integrate APIs/web services for enterprise applications.
* Ensure production readiness: CI/CD, monitoring, observability, performance tuning, and cost optimization.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and IT teams to deliver end\-to\-end AI solutions.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  




* 4–10 years in software/AI engineering with strong Python skills.
* Hands\-on experience with traditional ML techniques, NLP pipelines, and using LLMs via APIs and SDKs.
* Prior experience building chatbots or conversational AI systems in production.
* Familiarity with ML/AI libraries and toolkits (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex/Semantic Kernel).
* Proven track record deploying AI applications on Azure.
* Experience with vector databases and embeddings for retrieval.
* Exposure to agentic systems and orchestrating multi\-step reasoning.
* Skilled at building APIs/microservices and integrating AI into enterprise systems.
* Familiar with MLOps practices: CI/CD, model lifecycle, monitoring, and scaling.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Haystack).
* Knowledge of prompt design, RAG workflows, and LLM integration best practices.
* Strong background in NLP pipelines (NER, sentiment, text classification, search).
* Experience with multimodal AI (text, audio, video), computer vision, or emotion analysis.
* Knowledge of data pipelines/ETL for AI workloads.
* Understanding of enterprise AI security, compliance, and governance.
* Azure certifications or prior enterprise\-scale Azure deployments.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




  





 We're a fast\-moving, Silicon Valley\-based, VC\-backed startup building ambitious, user\-
 



 facing products at the intersection of modern web applications and AI\-powered systems.
 



  





 From the heart of Chennai, we’re building for global scale, focused on speed, ownership,
 



 and creating high\-impact products from the ground up.
 



 We’re at a stage where the foundations are being built and scaled, which means the people
 



 who join now will directly shape how the product, platform, and engineering practices
 



 evolve.
 



 We are an AI\-first company. AI is part of how we think, build, test, and ship.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for AI Engineers at the beginning of their engineering journey who are
 



 excited to learn, build, experiment, and ship.
 



 This is not a traditional frontend, backend, or QA role. You’ll work across the entire
 



  





 product engineering lifecycle, building user\-facing experiences, backend systems, AI\-
 



 powered workflows, deployments, automation, and quality based on what the product needs.
 



 You’ll work closely with experienced engineers and get hands\-on experience building a real
 



 product from the ground up.
 



 You won’t just be learning how software is built. You’ll be building it.
 



  





**You’ll be:** 




 ● Building and shipping real product features
 



 ● Working across frontend, backend, AI, DevOps, and quality
 



 ● Using AI as part of your everyday engineering workflow
 



 ● Solving real product and engineering problems
 



 ● Learning by working on production systems
 



  





**Core Competencies: What You Will Do** 




 ● Build across the stack: Work on frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, deployments,
 



 AI workflows, and quality based on what the product requires.
 



 ● Build with AI: Use AI tools to understand problems, write and improve code, debug,
 



 test, and accelerate your engineering workflow.
 



 ● Build AI\-powered products: Work with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, prompt engineering,
 



 semantic search, embeddings, or other AI capabilities as required.
 



 ● Ship real product: Take features from understanding the problem through
 



 implementation, testing, and production.
 



 ● Solve problems independently: Break down unfamiliar problems, explore solutions,
 



 and make practical technical decisions.
 



 ● Build quality into your work: Think about edge cases, test your changes, debug
 



 issues, and ensure what you build works reliably.
 



 ● Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, product, and other teams to turn
 



 ideas into working software.
 



 ● Experiment and improve: Explore new technologies, AI capabilities, and
 



 engineering approaches that can help us build better products.
 



  





**Skills \& Capability Stack: What You Need to Succeed** 




 ● 0–2 years of experience, including fresh graduates and candidates with strong
 



 project or internship experience
 



 ● Strong fundamentals in computer science, programming, data structures, and
 



 algorithms
 



 ● Strong logical and analytical problem\-solving ability
 



 ● Basic understanding of software development, APIs, databases, and web
 



 applications
 



 ● Hands\-on interest or experience in AI/ML, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, AI Agents,
 



 RAG, or related areas
 



 ● Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic
 



 search, vector databases, or fine\-tuning is a plus
 



 ● Experience building AI\-powered applications, automation, chatbots, intelligent
 



 workflows, or full\-stack projects is a strong plus
 



 ● Familiarity with modern development tools, Git, APIs, cloud platforms, or
 



 deployment environments
 



 ● Ability to learn technologies outside your existing skill set
 



 ● Strong communication and collaboration skills
 



 What We Look For Beyond the Resume
 



 We care less about how many technologies you can list and more about what you’ve
 



 actually built.
 



  





**This could include:** 




 ● Strong personal or academic projects
 



 ● AI/ML or full\-stack projects taken from idea to implementation
 



 ● Internships involving real applications or systems
 



 ● Hackathons, coding competitions, or technical challenges
 



 ● Open\-source contributions
 



 ● AI experiments that demonstrate curiosity and problem\-solving
 



 Tech Environment: What You’ll Work With
 



 ● Claude Code
 



 ● Codex
 



 ● Grok
 



 ● AI\-assisted development tools
 



 ● LLMs and Generative AI systems
 



 ● AI agents and intelligent workflows
 



 ● Modern web and backend technologies
 



 ● Cloud and deployment environments
 



 ● Automation and testing tools
 



 ● Emerging AI and engineering tools
 



  





 You’re not expected to come in with a fixed toolbox. The expectation is that you can learn,
 



 adapt, experiment, and use the right tools to solve the problem in front of you.
 



  





**What Makes You a Great Fit** 




 ● You’re genuinely excited about AI and what it can change about software
 



 engineering.
 



 ● You have a builder mindset and enjoy turning ideas into working products.
 



 ● You’re curious and comfortable figuring out things you don’t know yet.
 



 ● You’re open to working across frontend, backend, AI, DevOps, and testing.
 



 ● You care about strong engineering fundamentals and reliable software.
 



 ● You take ownership of your work and follow problems through to completion.
 



 ● You’re comfortable in a fast\-moving environment without a predefined playbook.
 



 ● You want to learn from experienced engineers while contributing to real production
 



 systems.
 



 ● You’re excited by the opportunity to build something new and potentially
 



 transformative from Chennai.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like: First 90–180 Days
 



 ● You understand how our product and engineering systems work end\-to\-end.
 



 ● You’ve shipped meaningful features into production.
 



 ● You’ve contributed across multiple areas of the engineering stack.
 



 ● You’re using AI effectively in your everyday engineering workflow.
 



 ● You can take a problem, build a solution, test it, and get it shipped with increasing
 



 independence.
 



 ● You’ve picked up new technologies based on what the product requires.
 



 ● You’re contributing ideas and becoming someone the team can trust to solve
 



 problems.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 We believe great teams build great products, which is why we invest deeply in our people:
 



 ● Competitive salary and meaningful ESOPs
 



 ● Comprehensive healthcare and insurance coverage
 



 ● Unlimited leave policy built on trust and ownership
 



 ● Real growth in scope, ownership, and technical influence as the company scales
 



 You’ll be joining a team building what the future of AI could look like, from Chennai,
 



 today. We’re solving problems and building products that are years ahead of where the
 



 industry is, giving you the opportunity to work on things that don’t have a playbook yet.
 



  





 As a fresher, you’ll get to learn across the engineering stack, work closely with
 



 experienced builders, and ship real products rather than being limited to a narrow role.
 



 If you want to be part of a company thinking beyond today, building at the edge of AI, and
 



 creating something genuinely transformative, this is the right place to be.
 



 If the idea of learning fast, building across the stack, and helping create something
 



 revolutionary excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

 Must\-Have Skills:
   

  

* Strong programming experience in Python and API development using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini.
* Build AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Semantic Kernel.
* Design and implement Agentic AI solutions, including multi\-agent workflows, tool orchestration, memory management, and human\-in\-the\-loop capabilities.
* Develop RAG solutions using embeddings, chunking, vector search, reranking, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), function calling, and enterprise tool integrations.
* Hands\-on experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, pgvector, FAISS, or Azure AI Search.
* Strong knowledge of Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering, prompt optimization, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) and enterprise data integration.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, debugging, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


 Good\-to\-Have Skills:
   

  

* Deploy and manage AI applications on AWS, Docker, and OpenShift/Kubernetes using CI/CD pipelines.
* Build secure, scalable AI solutions with monitoring, guardrails, observability, and Responsible AI practices.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, and engineering teams to deliver AI\-powered enterprise solutions

Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
**Department: AI Reinvent \& Engineering, Enterprise AI**
**Company: Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)**
**Bengaluru, India**
 Are you excited about using AI to improve patients' lives? Do you thrive on crafting and delivering high\-quality products? Do you enjoy collaborating in a dynamic, multinational environment with experts from different domains? Then you might be interested in joining Enterprise AI, an area of AI and data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and AI enablement experts in Novo Nordisk's Enterprise IT. Apply today to \#BringDataToLife with AI!
   

  

**Your new role**
 In the AI Engineering Solutions team, you will turn strategic AI use cases into reliable products that create value across Novo Nordisk and for the patients we serve. You will be hired into AI Reinvent \& Engineering, while much of your work will take place in cross\-functional product teams across areas such as Commercial, Global Manufacturing \& Supply as well as in strategic initiatives across the business. Working with product managers, domain experts, data scientists, engineers, and the AI Foundation team, you will ideally bring a strong software\-engineering foundation, applied AI experience and a product mindset. A central part of the role is determining whether a problem calls for conventional software or rules, optimization, a predictive model, retrieval\-grounded GenAI or a carefully bounded agentic workflow. You will provide technical direction for complex use cases, align stakeholders, and help other engineers do their best work.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Taking AI\- and ML\-centric use cases from discovery and rapid prototyping through production and continuous improvement, collaborating with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and domain experts
* Engineering the product\-specific intelligence layer, including data and feature transformations, decision logic, model and tool integrations, knowledge grounding, user\-facing services, human\-oversight controls and appropriate fallback behaviour
* Partnering with stakeholders and product managers to frame problems, shape the build, agree priorities, and define meaningful product outcomes
* Using AI\-assisted development tools and coding agents productively and responsibly while maintaining high standards for code quality and review
* Engineering reliable, scalable, secure, and observable solutions with appropriate testing, evaluation, documentation, and CI/CD practices
* Applying Responsible AI, data integrity, validation, traceability, and auditability requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment
* Working with the AI Foundation team to reuse shared capabilities and turn lessons from individual deliveries into reusable components and engineering patterns
* Providing technical direction for complex use cases, aligning stakeholders, and coaching engineers without relying on formal authority


**Your new team**
 In Enterprise AI, you will be part of a business area that drives impact across the full Novo Nordisk value chain. We stay close to colleagues in the business so that we solve relevant problems and deliver solutions that support millions of people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 Within Enterprise AI, AI Reinvent \& Engineering turns AI opportunities into products. The AI Engineering Solutions team brings together engineers with different strengths across statistics, machine learning, AI, and software engineering. Although you belong to this engineering community, your day\-to\-day work will often happen in cross\-functional product teams in Commercial, Global Manufacturing \& Supply, and other business areas. This lets us stay close to the problems while maintaining strong links to shared engineering practices and the AI Foundation team.
   

  

 We are cloud\-native and work across technologies such as Azure and AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, foundation\-model APIs, and modern AI application frameworks. We value technical rigour, experimentation, direct feedback, and continuous learning.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Qualifications**
 We are looking for Lead AI Engineer candidates who enjoy translating technology into business impact and working closely with product teams and stakeholders. All candidates should have a solid foundation in software delivery, production AI, and cross\-functional product collaboration. Deep expertise in selected areas is an advantage, but candidates are not expected to excel across every aspect of AI engineering. You will ideally bring:
   

  

* Typically 8\+ years of relevant experience building AI or software products; demonstrated scope and capability matter more than tenure alone
* Experience taking AI\-centric applications from idea to production and/or contributing to a product or platform team
* Hands\-on experience operating AI solutions in production, including evaluation, monitoring, reliability, and cost\-performance trade\-offs
* A sound foundation in statistical and machine\-learning concepts together with practical experience of modern AI application patterns
* Strong programming and software engineering skills, including testing, documentation, APIs, and modern development practices such as CI/CD, preferably with GitHub
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools and coding agents effectively as part of software delivery
* Functional knowledge of modern AI interfaces and standards, such as model and tool integrations, MCP, and observability approaches
* Product sense and the ability to work with stakeholders to clarify needs, shape solutions, and explain technical choices to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Ability to set technical direction, align complex stakeholder groups, and coach engineers across delivery teams
* Demonstrated ability to set technical direction across multiple AI deliveries or teams, resolve ambiguous cross\-team trade\-offs, and raise engineering standards through coaching and reusable patterns
* A collaborative mindset, good listening skills, self\-motivation, and continuous curiosity about the evolving field of AI
* B.E/M.E/B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related technical discipline


**Additional Desirable But Not Required Skills Include**
* Familiarity with pharma\-specific AI domains: clinical NLP, drug discovery AI, regulatory automation, or medical knowledge graphs
* Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Azure ML, and Unity Catalog in an enterprise data/AI platform context
* Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) server design and enterprise AI platform architecture patterns


**Working at Novo Nordisk**
 Every day we seek solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. We approach our work with determination, curiosity, and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For more than 100 years, this dedication has shaped a company focused on lasting change for long\-term health. In AI Reinvent \& Engineering, your work will help turn AI into reliable products used across a global healthcare company.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 At Novo Nordisk, you'll join a global healthcare company with a distinct culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
   

  

 At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

description:

**Job Description: AI Engineer – Infrastructure \& Cloud**
**Title** 
 : AI Engineer
   

  

**Level** 
 : Manager
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 10\-12 years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Architect to sit at the intersection of Infrastructure and Artificial Intelligence — someone who can design, build, and operationalize AI/LLM/Agentic solutions that solve real infrastructure problems: capacity planning, incident response, observability, automation, cost optimization, and resiliency engineering. This is not a pure research role — it's an applied engineering \+ architecture role for someone who can code, ship, and integrate AI into production infra workflows.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and deliver AI/ML/LLM\-based solutions embedded into infrastructure operations (ITOps/AIOps, self\-healing systems, predictive capacity, automated RCA)
* Design and build agentic AI workflows (multi\-step, tool\-using agents) for infra automation — ticketing, monitoring, remediation, provisioning
* Evaluate, fine\-tune, and integrate LLMs (open\-source and commercial: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, local/open models) into enterprise infra tooling
* Build RAG pipelines, vector databases, and knowledge\-grounding systems over infra documentation, runbooks, and CMDB data
* Write production\-grade code (Python primarily; scripting in Bash/PowerShell) — this role codes, doesn't just design PPTs
* Integrate AI solutions with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), ITSM tools (ServiceNow), observability stacks (Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana), and CI/CD pipelines
* Define and enforce AI governance guardrails — data privacy, model security, hallucination control, cost/token management
* Partner with infra leadership to identify high\-ROI AI use cases and build the roadmap
* Mentor infra engineers on AI\-adjacent skills; act as the internal AI Center of Excellence lead for the infra vertical
* Own POC → pilot → production lifecycle for AI initiatives, including MLOps/LLMOps practices


**Must\-Have Skills**
* 10–12 years in Infrastructure/Cloud engineering or architecture, with the last 3–4 years focused on applied AI/ML/LLM work
* Strong hands\-on coding ability — Python (must), API integration, SDK usage (OpenAI/Anthropic/LangChain/LlamaIndex)
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompting, fine\-tuning, embeddings, RAG, context windows, tokens/cost
* Practical experience building agentic AI systems (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom orchestration) with tool\-calling/function\-calling
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Azure AI Search, etc.)
* Deep infra background: cloud architecture, networking, virtualization, ITSM, monitoring/observability, automation (Ansible/Terraform)
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps — model deployment, monitoring, versioning, cost governance
* Strong architecture and solutioning skills — can whiteboard an end\-to\-end system and defend design tradeoffs


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Certifications: AWS/Azure/GCP AI or Solutions Architect
* Exposure to enterprise AI governance/responsible AI frameworks
* Experience presenting to CXO/leadership on AI strategy and business cases
* Prior experience in a Big 4 / GDS / large enterprise infra environment
* Open\-source contributions or published POCs in AI/agentic systems


**Soft Skills**
* Ability to translate ambiguous infra pain points into AI\-solvable use cases
* Strong stakeholder management — bridges infra teams, data science teams, and business
* Comfortable being hands\-on (code/architecture) as well as strategic (roadmap, governance)


**EY \| Building a better working world**

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AI Transformation Engineer
description:
**About Dialpad**
 Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.
   

  

 Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.
   

  

 Market\-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T\-Mobile.
   

  

**Being a Dialer**
 At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.
   

  

 We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.
   

  

 We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits:
 **Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic** 
 .
   

  

**Your role**
 As an AI Engineer, the selected candidate will build and ship AI\-powered tools alongside a small, technically focused team. This is a hands\-on engineering role: the candidate will write Python, work with LLMs and agent frameworks, integrate APIs, and help deploy systems that real business teams depend on. Guidance will be provided by senior engineers and the AI Engineering Manager, and the successful candidate is expected to grow quickly — both in AI engineering depth and in the ability to take on problems with increasing independence over time. This role is based in India and reports to the AI Engineering Manager. The candidate must be available for overlap with the core team during morning IST hours to support collaboration and code reviews across time zones.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, build, and maintain production\-grade AI systems, including multi\-agent workflows, RAG applications, workflow automation, and LLM\-powered services.
* Lead the technical implementation of complex AI initiatives from discovery through deployment.
* Architect scalable backend services, APIs, evaluation pipelines, and retrieval systems.
* Improve reliability, observability, and performance of production AI applications.
* Define engineering standards, reusable components, and best practices for AI development.
* Collaborate directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into scalable AI solutions.

* Build evaluation frameworks and automated testing strategies for LLM\-based systems.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and design discussions.
* Participate in architectural planning, sprint planning, technical reviews, and cross\-functional initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvements in engineering processes, documentation, and operational excellence.


**Skills You’ll Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, AI engineering, or a similar technical role.
* Strong Python development skills with experience building and maintaining production systems.
* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompting techniques, structured outputs, tool calling, function calling, and AI application architectures.
* Experience designing and deploying RAG systems, including chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval optimization, reranking, and evaluation.
* Experience building agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain,, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar.
* Experience integrating external APIs and enterprise systems.
* Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including testing, CI/CD, observability, monitoring, and production deployments.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) and containerized applications.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to independently manage projects and influence technical decisions across teams.


**Why Join Dialpad**
* Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
* Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
* Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth


 We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting\-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.
   

  

 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

*Dialpad is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.*

**Must have skills required:**
 ai adoption and experimentation, experience building with browser agents, ai\-native projects, GCP / AWS, problem solver, Python (FastAPI), strong executor
   

  

**a WhatsApp\-based personal assistant is Looking for:**
**Senior AI Engineer******
 Like other things at FF, we do JDs differently. We feel exceptional people care deeply about their work, and therefore, we think deeply about what we write here.
   

  

**Building in consumer\-tech is a lot like falling in love slowly at first, then all at once.\***
**Our Story:**
 We started in Sept ''24 with a thesis and a strong desire to solve for Indian consumers. we realised busy working professionals were spending several hours every week on chores. Despite the popular narrative that "
 **there''s an app for everything"** 
 , we noticed that for more than 500 use cases, no good solution existed. We wanted to offer people a personal assistant that could do all these things for them. The traditional personal assistant has several limitations, including that it is not affordable, has limited working hours, and has limited intelligence and capabilities. It clicked for us that a lot of what a personal assistant does (like calling, coordination, bookings, getting information) is exactly the kind of thing that can be automated using technology that has just hit an inflection point.
   

  

 We started out by becoming the personal assistant for people, asking them what they needed help with. People could hire us for Rs. 2000 per month to delegate any of their personal chores, including government work, household management, travel, appointments, and a lot more. In the first three months, we did about 500 tasks and noticed that people found a lot of value in having faff as a service. They were using us week on week, renewing month on month, and telling everyone they knew about us. These were the early signs for us that we’re in the right direction.
   

  

 In the next few months, we built our operations team, internal playbooks, and training modules. We also built technology on top of WhatsApp and internal tooling to make our operations team productive. till now, we have finished close to 15,000 tasks and have an active paying user base that is using us on a weekly basis. The user love we have seen for our service makes us confident that there is a deep unmet need waiting to be fulfilled.
   

  

 Even though we feel confident that we are onto something, we are still a little far away from the final step of what potentially could be one of the most impactful consumer companies in this country. Nexus VP is a global venture capital firm that has previously backed category\-creating companies like Zepto, Unacademy, and Snapdeal, and has decided to invest over $2\.5 million to help us in our journey.  We feel there are several great Indian internet companies yet to be built, and we have a shot at making one. if you would like to be early in this journey and become an influential member of the story, this is likely the perfect time to join us.

As an AI engineer, you will be building products on the cutting edge of technology \- voice agents, browser agents, memory, and more. That superhuman level of productivity is only possible by being on top of the AI curve and executing with extreme urgency.
   

  

 We already have voice agents in production, automating around half of the calls today. We work closely with our ops team and solve their problems by building tools for them. What used to feel like a mountain a few months back is easily doable by half the people using the smart internal tools we have built. You’ll be the owner of your own project and work with the rest of the team to find deep pain points and solve them. We’ve built only 1% of the product’s capabilities, and if you like beautiful software that helps the end consumer directly, this is the right place to be.
   

  

**Ideal candidate:**
 The right person for this role will be a great problem solver, quick learner, and strong executor. They will be able to pick up new technologies and ship products in a matter of weeks. We don''t have any strict constraints on past experience, but we believe the right kind of person will have 1\-3 years of professional work experience and \*solid\* proof of work.

**First** 
 , someone deeply technical who has worked on complex technical problems across multiple tech stacks. they \-

* Have a fundamental understanding of classical machine learning models as well as the latest trends around tool\-augmented reasoning, and model fine\-tuning techniques like QLoRA.

description:

Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly experienced software developer to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI\-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU\-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter\-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI\-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready\-to\-use applications for developers. Embracing open\-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R\&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, Strike team is a new sub team, within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm both to consult on ideas and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end\-to\-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will work independently, exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time\-bound fashion, and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group\-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant’s mindset, be able to learn the group’s setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. You will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional and clear communication skills. Lastly, you will be expected to mentor the staff from respective groups to allow for a smooth handover of projects, which will be a key part of the job.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 7 to 12 years of relevant industry work experience as a specialist/individual contributor
* Proficiency in Python with exceptional coding and debugging abilities
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
* Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication skills


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* GAI academic qualifications/certifications

title: Technical Lead- Data Platform
description:
**About The Company**
**Who are we?**
 Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e\-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.
   

  

 We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
   

  

 Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self\-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.
   

  

 We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
   

  

 From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.
   

  

 Working at Myntra is challenging but fun \- we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.
   

  

**Technical Lead – Data Engineering**
 Myntra Data Platform (MDP) \| Bengaluru \| 6\+ Years
   

  

**About The Role**
 Myntra Data Platform (MDP) powers the data foundation behind analytics, experimentation, personalization, ML and critical business decisions across Myntra.
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Lead – Data Engineering to build and evolve large\-scale data processing, ETL and orchestration platforms, while helping shape the next generation of AI\-native and agentic data engineering at Myntra.
   

  

 This is a senior individual\-contributor role requiring deep technical ownership—from architecture and production\-quality code to performance optimization, troubleshooting and operational excellence.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Spark, SQL, ETL, workflow orchestration, data modeling and modern lakehouse architectures.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Large\-Scale Batch Processing
   

  

* Design, build and optimize large\-scale batch processing systems using Apache Spark, PySpark and Spark SQL.
* Build production\-grade pipelines handling high\-volume transformations, joins and aggregations.
* Apply deep understanding of Spark DAGs, stages, shuffles, partitioning, joins, caching, memory and query plans.
* Diagnose data skew, shuffles, memory pressure, inefficient joins and partitioning issues.
* Optimize execution time, compute utilization and cost.
* Build reusable Spark libraries, frameworks and engineering patterns.


 ETL \& Data Pipeline Engineering
   

  

* Build reliable ETL/ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment and publishing.
* Develop reusable pipeline frameworks and abstractions rather than one\-off solutions.
* Design for incremental processing, backfills, retries, idempotency, dependencies and failure recovery.
* Ensure correctness, freshness, scalability and maintainability.
* Own pipelines from architecture → development → deployment → production operations.


 Workflow Orchestration
   

  

* Design and operate large\-scale workflows using Apache Airflow, Dagster or equivalent platforms.
* Orchestrate complex dependencies across Spark, SQL and data\-processing workloads.
* Build reusable operators, components and orchestration patterns.
* Improve scheduling, retries, backfills, dependency management and operational visibility.
* Build self\-service capabilities for developing, deploying and operating data pipelines at scale.


 Databricks \& Lakehouse Engineering
   

  

* Build and operate large\-scale workloads on Databricks and Spark\-based environments.
* Design lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Parquet or equivalent technologies.
* Optimize partitioning, file sizing, compaction, metadata, Spark and SQL workloads for performance and cost.
* Build platform capabilities that simplify compute, storage and data consumption.


 SQL, dbt, Data Transformation \& Data Modeling
   

  

* Develop and optimize complex production\-grade SQL and Spark SQL transformations.
* Build modular transformation models using dbt or equivalent frameworks.
* Establish standards for SQL quality, testing, documentation and dependency management.
* Troubleshoot expensive queries using execution/query plans.
* Design scalable relational, dimensional and lakehouse data models.
* Apply fact/dimension modeling, star schemas, SCDs and incremental models where appropriate.
* Translate business and analytical requirements into reusable data models across raw, curated and consumption\-ready layers.


 Agentic Data Engineering
   

  

* Build AI\-native data engineering capabilities across the end\-to\-end pipeline lifecycle.
* Design AI\-assisted workflows that translate requirements into data models, SQL/Spark transformations and executable pipelines.
* Build agents that understand schemas, metadata, lineage, business semantics and existing pipelines.
* Apply LLMs/agents to SQL and pipeline generation, code review, testing, documentation and optimization.
* Build intelligent Spark/SQL optimization and pipeline RCA using execution plans, job metrics, logs, dependencies and historical performance.
* Automate generation of data\-quality checks, tests, documentation and lineage metadata.
* Build natural\-language/semantic interfaces for data discovery and safe pipeline creation/modification.
* Integrate agents with Airflow/Dagster, dbt, Databricks, Spark and metadata/catalog platforms.
* Design human\-in\-the\-loop controls, validation, guardrails and evaluations for AI\-generated SQL, code and pipelines.
* Build reusable agent frameworks, tools and APIs, not isolated AI demos.


 Data Quality \& Governance
   

  

* Embed data quality into pipelines with automated freshness, completeness, schema and consistency checks.
* Establish standards for metadata, ownership, lineage and discoverability.
* Integrate with Unity Catalog or equivalent governance/catalog platforms.
* Design controls for PII, access management, auditing and sensitive data.
* Ensure AI\-generated and human\-authored pipelines follow the same quality, security and governance standards.


 Reliability \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Own production health of critical pipelines and platform components.
* Monitor failures, SLAs, freshness, data quality, performance and cost.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of complex incidents.
* Eliminate recurring operational problems through automation, platform improvements and intelligent tooling.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Remain deeply hands\-on while providing technical direction.
* Lead architecture/design reviews and review Spark, Python and SQL implementations.
* Mentor engineers across Spark, ETL, SQL, data modeling and production engineering.
* Build reusable frameworks and engineering standards adopted across teams.
* Drive responsible adoption of AI\-assisted engineering.
* Lead complex cross\-team initiatives and influence architecture without direct authority.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 6\+ years of hands\-on Data Engineering / Software Engineering experience building production data systems at scale.
* Deep expertise in Apache Spark / PySpark, Spark SQL and Spark internals.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java or Scala.
* Advanced SQL, query optimization and performance\-debugging skills.
* Strong experience building production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Experience with Airflow, Dagster or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience with Databricks or comparable Spark\-based platforms.
* Experience with dbt or SQLMesh
* Strong understanding of data modeling and lakehouse architecture.
* Experience with Parquet, Delta Lake and/or Apache Iceberg.
* Experience with data quality, metadata, lineage and governance.
* Strong production ownership—from design and implementation through operations and RCA.
* Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture, code reviews and mentoring.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience building LLM\-powered developer tools, AI agents or engineering automation.
* Understanding of LLMs, tool/function calling, RAG, structured generation and agentic workflows.
* Experience applying AI to SQL generation, data discovery, pipeline generation, debugging or optimization.
* Experience with metadata catalogs, semantic layers, lineage or knowledge graphs for AI context.
* Experience building evaluations and guardrails for AI\-generated SQL/code.
* Experience building multi\-tenant/self\-service data platforms, frameworks or SDKs.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and Unity Catalog or similar governance platforms.


 What Makes This Role Different
   

  

 You will build the engineering foundations that enable data engineering at Myntra scale — Spark processing, orchestration, ETL frameworks, data modeling, lakehouse architecture, governance and production reliability.
   

  

 At the same time, you will help redefine data engineering for an agentic world — where agents understand data and dependencies, accelerate the journey from intent to production pipelines, automate repetitive engineering work, and operate within strong human\-controlled guardrails.
   

  

 We are looking for someone comfortable moving between Spark execution plans, Python, SQL, Airflow/Dagster DAGs, dbt models, metadata and platform architecture — and excited about making these workflows dramatically better with AI.
   

  

 Build the data platform of today — and help define how data engineering will work tomorrow.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 data platform, design, apache, spark, kafka, problem solving skills

title: Strategy and Operations Intern
description:
**Strategy \& Operations Intern**
=================================

**About Sarvam**
----------------


Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full\-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**
------------------


Sarvam's Strategy and Operations team sits at the centre of how the revenue function runs: the systems, the data, and the analysis behind who we sell to and where the team focuses its effort. The company is growing quickly, and this function scales with it.


This role works on making that engine sharper. You will take a part of it, study how it performs today, form a view on what would make it better, and then build that. The work is analytical first and hands\-on second. We are AI\-first in how we work, so what you can ship is set by your judgment.


You will work directly with sales, marketing, and leadership, and your output goes into decisions.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Market and opportunity sizing.** Build bottom\-up models for segments we are entering, and quantify where the next set of revenue comes from.

**Funnel and conversion analysis.** Follow the path from signup to revenue, find where it can improve, and build the instrumentation and reporting that makes it visible.

**Account and competitive research.** Sharpen where the team spends its time with research on target accounts, segments, and competitors.

**Revenue systems.** Strengthen the systems the team runs on, including how our CRM represents accounts, deals, and product usage.

**Reporting the team relies on.** Build and maintain the recurring reporting that sales, marketing, and leadership use to run the business.

**Programs and execution.** Take the initiatives that come out of the above and land them, along with the documentation and walkthroughs that make them stick.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


Final\-year student or recent graduate, any discipline


Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort working with structured data; SQL is a plus


Precision as a default, with the patience to trace a number back to its source


Research discipline, with sources cited and measured facts kept separate from assumptions


The ability to reduce a large, messy dataset to the two or three findings that matter


Comfort picking up an unfamiliar problem and a new tool at the same time


Clear, concise writing, for readers who were not in the room

**Bonus Points**
----------------


Exposure to a CRM, BI, or marketing automation platform in any capacity


Python or basic scripting for data work


A prior internship involving data analysis, market research, or sales and marketing operations


Genuine interest in AI and the enterprise technology market

**Why Sarvam?**
---------------


Sarvam is a fast\-moving, high talent\-density team building full\-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population\-scale impact.


Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar


High ownership and high impact, from day one


Everything we do is AI\-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems


You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates


If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Cyber Security Operations Analyst (Tier 2 SOC)
description:
**About Marvell**


Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.


At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**


Joining Marvell as a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will play a critical role in protecting Marvell's people, data, intellectual property, and infrastructure from evolving cyber threats. As part of the Security Operations Center (SOC), the central nervous system of Marvell's cybersecurity organization, you will be responsible not only for monitoring, detection, investigation, and response, but also for driving innovation through Artificial Intelligence (AI), Security Automation, and proactive Threat Hunting.  

This role requires a security professional who thinks beyond traditional SOC operations, continuously stays ahead of emerging threats and industry trends, and proactively identifies opportunities to leverage automation and AI technologies to improve detection, response, efficiency, and security outcomes. You will collaborate across global security teams, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to strengthen Marvell's cyber defenses while helping shape the future of SOC operations.**What You Can Expect**

**Security Operations \& Incident Response**

* Provide primary triage, investigation, analysis, and operational support for security alerts and events across the enterprise.
* Perform advanced correlation using SIEM, EDR, NDR, threat intelligence platforms, forensic tools, malware analysis tools, and data analytics platforms.
* Conduct real\-time incident handling, including intrusion investigation, threat containment, remediation, and recovery activities.
* Analyze security incidents to determine root cause, attack path, scope of compromise, and business impact.
* Develop and maintain incident response procedures, playbooks, and detection methodologies.
* Effectively communicate security events, risks, and response activities to technical and executive stakeholders.

**Threat Hunting \& Detection Engineering**

* Conduct proactive threat hunting exercises using internal telemetry, threat intelligence, attacker TTPs, and hypothesis\-driven hunting methodologies.
* Leverage MITRE ATT\&CK and other threat frameworks to identify detection gaps and improve security visibility.
* Transform threat hunting findings into operationalized detections, use cases, analytics rules, and response playbooks.
* Identify emerging attacker techniques and develop corresponding monitoring and alerting strategies.
* Collaborate with threat intelligence teams to operationalize Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and adversary TTPs.

**Security Automation \& SOC Optimization**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks and improve SOC efficiency through scripting, orchestration, and workflow automation.
* Design and implement SOAR playbooks and automated response workflows.
* Drive false\-positive reduction initiatives through analytics tuning, machine learning insights, and detection optimization.
* Continuously improve detection coverage, incident response speed, and operational metrics through automation and innovation.

**AI Security \& Innovation**

* Research, evaluate, and recommend AI\-driven security technologies and capabilities for SOC operations.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Security Copilots to improve threat detection, investigation, triage, threat hunting, and reporting.
* Develop ideas and use cases for AI integration across cybersecurity operations.
* Assess security risks associated with AI systems deployed within the enterprise.
* Monitor emerging AI\-related threats, adversarial machine learning attacks and industry trends
* Contribute to the development of AI security monitoring use cases, detections, and response procedures.
* Use AI\-assisted analytics responsibly to accelerate investigations while maintaining analytical rigor.
* Stay current on the evolving cybersecurity landscape, attacker methodologies, AI advancements, vulnerability trends, and emerging technologies.
* Actively contribute innovative ideas that enhance detection, automation, AI adoption, and overall SOC maturity.
* Participate in purple team exercises, tabletop simulations, attack emulations, and security validation activities.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4\+ years of experience as a SOC Analyst, Threat Hunter, Detection Engineer, or Incident Responder, preferably supporting a global enterprise with 5,000\+ employees.
* Demonstrated experience in security operations, threat hunting, incident response, automation and detection engineering.
* Experience integrating automation into SOC workflows and operational processes.
* Experience evaluating or utilizing AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity workflows is highly desirable.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep understanding of MITRE ATT\&CK framework with proven experience building detections, hunting methodologies, and response playbooks based on attacker TTPs.
* Strong knowledge of modern attack techniques, cyber kill chain methodologies, and advanced persistent threat (APT) operations.
* Experience conducting intelligence\-driven and hypothesis\-driven threat hunts.
* Ability to convert threat intelligence and hunting results into actionable detections
* Experience with one or more SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, Elastic, or Chronicle.
* Experience with SOAR platforms and security workflow automation.
* Proficiency with DLP technologies and data protection controls.
* Strong working knowledge of SOC tools and technologies.

**AI \& Emerging Security Requirements**

* Strong understanding of AI security concepts, risks, and attack methodologies.
* Deep Knowledge of AI based attacks and risks
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve detection, investigation, response, reporting, and SOC productivity.
* Interest in evaluating and operationalizing AI solutions to enhance cybersecurity outcomes.

**Problem Solving \& Innovation**

* Demonstrated ability to think creatively and challenge conventional approaches to security operations.
* Strong analytical and investigative mindset with the ability to solve complex problems amid ambiguity.
* Passion for continuous learning, staying current with cybersecurity and AI trends, and bringing innovative ideas to the organization.
* Self\-motivated with a track record of delivering end\-to\-end solutions in fast\-paced, technology\-driven environments.

**Communication**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executives, technical teams, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Certifications**

* GIAC Certifications (GCFA, GCIH, GCIA, GMON, GCTI, etc.)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* AI Security Certifications (where applicable)


This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long\-term success.
**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**


With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

**Interview Integrity**


To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real\-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note\-taking bots) during interviews.


These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

As such, applicants must be eligible to access export\-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State.
